title: Perception or Prejudice: Can MLLMs Go Beyond First Impressions of Personality?
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in human-facing roles where personality perception is critical, yet existing benchmarks evaluate this capability solely on numerical Big Five score prediction, leaving open whether models truly perceive personality through behavioral understanding or merely prejudge through superficial pattern matching. We address this gap with three contributions. (i) A new task: we formalize Grounded Personality Reasoning (GPR), which requires MLLMs to anchor each Big Five rating in observable evidence through a chain of rating, reasoning, and grounding. (ii) A new dataset: we release MM-OCEAN (1,104 videos, 5,320 MCQs), produced by a multi-agent pipeline with human verification, with timestamped behavioral observations, evidence-grounded trait analyses, and seven categories of cue-grounding MCQs. (iii) Benchmark and analysis: we design a three-tier evaluation (rating, reasoning, grounding) plus four sample-level failure-mode metrics: Prejudice Rate (PR), Confabulation Rate (CR), Integration-failure Rate (IR), and Holistic-grounding Rate (HR), and benchmark 27 MLLMs (13 closed, 14 open). The analysis uncovers a striking Prejudice Gap: across the field, 51% of correct ratings are not grounded in retrieved cues, and the Holistic-Grounding Rate spans only 0-33.5%. These findings expose a disconnect between getting the right score and reasoning for the right reason, charting a roadmap for grounded social cognition in MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Grounded Personality Reasoning (GPR)任务，构建MM-OCEAN数据集（1,104视频，5,320 MCQ），设计三层次评估（评分、推理、接地）及四个故障模式指标，对27个MLLM进行基准测试，发现51%的正确评分未基于可检索线索，揭示MLLM存在严重的"偏见差距"。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM人格感知基准仅评估大五人格分数预测，无法区分模型是真正通过行为理解来感知人格，还是仅通过表面模式匹配进行预判。
AI.method: (i) 提出Grounded Personality Reasoning (GPR)任务，要求MLLM将每个大五评分锚定在可观察证据上，形成评分-推理-接地链；(ii) 构建MM-OCEAN数据集（1,104视频，5,320 MCQ），采用多智能体流水线+人工验证，包含时间戳行为观察、证据接地特质分析及七类线索接地MCQ；(iii) 设计三层次评估（评分、推理、接地）及四个故障指标：偏见率(PR)、虚构率(CR)、整合失败率(IR)、整体接地率(HR)。
AI.result: 基准测试27个MLLM（13个闭源，14个开源），发现51%的正确评分未接地于检索线索，整体接地率仅0-33.5%，揭示严重的偏见差距。
AI.conclusion: MLLM在人格感知中存在"得分正确但推理错误"的脱节问题，需要发展接地社会认知能力。

A three-tier evaluation framework (rating, reasoning, grounding) with four sample-level failure-mode metrics: Prejudice Rate (PR), Confabulation Rate (CR), Integration-failure Rate (IR), and Holistic-grounding Rate (HR)

A method to detect and quantify the Prejudice Gap in MLLM personality perception by comparing rating accuracy vs. evidence grounding quality

title: Efficient Agentic Reasoning Through Self-Regulated Simulative Planning
comment: Code and model artifacts are available at https://github.com/sailing-lab/sr2am
summary: How should an agent decide when and how to plan? A dominant approach builds agents as reactive policies with adaptive computation (e.g., chain-of-thought), trained end-to-end expecting planning to emerge implicitly. Without control over the presence, structure, or horizon of planning, these systems dramatically increase reasoning length, yielding inefficient token use without reliable accuracy gains. We argue efficient agentic reasoning benefits from decomposing decision-making into three systems: simulative reasoning (System II) grounding deliberation in future-state prediction via a world model; self-regulation (System III) deciding when and how deeply to plan via a learned configurator; and reactive execution (System I) handling fine-grained action. Simulative reasoning provides unified planning across diverse tasks without per-domain engineering, while self-regulation ensures the planner is invoked only when needed. To test this, we develop SR$^2$AM (Self-Regulated Simulative Reasoning Agentic LLM), realizing both as distinct stages within an LLM's chain-of-thought, with the LLM as world model. We explore two instantiations: recording decisions from a prompted multi-module system (v0.1) and reconstructing structured plans from traces of pretrained reasoning LLMs (v1.0), trained via supervised then reinforcement learning (RL). Across math, science, tabular analysis, and web information seeking, v0.1-8B and v1.0-30B achieve Pass@1 competitive with 120-355B and 685B-1T parameter systems respectively, while v1.0-30B uses 25.8-95.3% fewer reasoning tokens than comparable agentic LLMs. RL increases average planning horizon by 22.8% while planning frequency grows only 2.0%, showing it learns to plan further ahead rather than more often. More broadly, learned self-regulation instantiates a principle we expect to extend beyond planning to how agents govern their own learning and adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SR$^2$AM框架，将智能体推理分解为三个系统：模拟推理（System II，基于世界模型进行未来状态预测）、自我调节（System III，通过可学习的配置器决定何时以及多深入地规划）和反应执行（System I，处理细粒度动作）。该框架在数学、科学、表格分析和网络信息检索等任务上，用8B和30B参数模型达到了百亿甚至万亿参数系统的竞争力，同时大幅减少了推理令牌使用量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于反应式策略的智能体（如思维链）将规划隐式地嵌入端到端训练中，无法控制规划的存在、结构或视野，导致推理长度急剧增加，令牌使用效率低下且准确性不稳定。需要一种可分解、可控制的推理架构。
AI.method: 提出SR$^2$AM框架，将决策分解为三个系统：System I（反应执行）、System II（模拟推理，基于世界模型进行未来状态预测）和System III（自我调节，学习式配置器决定何时及如何深度规划）。以LLM作为世界模型，在思维链中实现不同阶段。两种实现方式：v0.1基于提示的多模块系统记录决策，v1.0从预训练推理LLM的轨迹中重建结构化规划，先监督学习再强化学习训练。
AI.result: v0.1-8B和v1.0-30B在Pass@1上分别与120-355B和685B-1T参数系统相当；v1.0-30B比同类智能体LLM减少25.8-95.3%的推理令牌。强化学习使平均规划视野提升22.8%，而规划频率仅增加2.0%，表明模型学会了更远地规划而非更频繁地规划。
AI.conclusion: 学习的自我调节机制不仅适用于规划，还可推广到智能体如何管理自身的学习和适应过程，具有更广泛的应用前景。
idea_en: A self-regulated simulative reasoning agent framework (SR$^2$AM) that decomposes decision-making into three distinct systems: reactive execution (System I), simulative reasoning with world model (System II), and self-regulation via a learned configurator (System III).
A method for using an LLM as the world model within chain-of-thought reasoning to perform unified simulative planning across diverse tasks without per-domain engineering.

A learned configurator (System III) trained via supervised learning followed by reinforcement learning that dynamically decides when and how deeply to engage in planning, enabling efficient token usage.
A technique for reconstructing structured plans from traces of pretrained reasoning LLMs (v1.0), transforming implicit reasoning into explicit controllable planning.
A reinforcement learning approach that increases planning horizon by 22.8% while only increasing planning frequency by 2.0%, teaching the agent to plan further ahead rather than more often.
A multi-module prompted system (v0.1) that records planning decisions from separate modules within an LLM's chain-of-thought for self-regulated reasoning.
idea_ch: 一种自调节模拟推理智能体框架（SR$^2$AM），将决策分解为三个独立系统：反应执行（System I）、基于世界模型的模拟推理（System II）以及通过可学习配置器实现的自调节（System III）。
一种利用LLM作为思维链内部世界模型的方法，实现跨不同任务的统一模拟规划，无需针对每个领域进行工程化设计。
一种通过监督学习结合强化学习训练的可学习配置器（System III），能够动态决定何时以及多深入地参与规划，实现高效的令牌使用。
一种从预训练推理LLM的轨迹中重建结构化规划的技术（v1.0），将隐式推理转化为显式可控的规划。
一种强化学习方法，使规划视野提升22.8%而规划频率仅增加2.0%，教会智能体规划得更远而非更频繁地规划。
一种基于提示的多模块系统（v0.1），在LLM思维链内从多个独立模块中记录规划决策，实现自调节推理。

title: Ratchet: A Minimal Hygiene Recipe for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Extends arXiv:2605.19576 with the SWE-bench Verified evaluation and a non-divergence analysis (Proposition 1)
summary: Self-evolving skill libraries, pioneered by Voyager, let frozen LLM agents accumulate reusable knowledge without weight updates, yet recent evaluation shows that LLM-authored skills deliver $+0.0$pp over no-skill baselines while human-curated ones deliver $+16.2$pp: the bottleneck is not skill authoring but lifecycle management. We introduce \textbf{Ratchet}, a single-agent loop in which a frozen LLM writes, retrieves, curates, and retires its own natural-language skills. Ratchet integrates four candidate hygiene mechanisms: outcome-driven retirement, a bounded active-cap, meta-skill authoring guidance, and pattern canonicalisation. On MBPP+ hard-100 with Claude Opus 4.7, Ratchet lifts held-out pass@1 from a $0.258 \pm 0.047$ baseline to a late-window rolling mean of $0.584$ (peak $0.658 \pm 0.042$) across 100 rounds and 3 seeds, a $+0.328 \pm 0.018$ rolling-mean gain where the no-skill control drifts at $+0.002 \pm 0.005$; the same recipe transfers to an agentic solver on SWE-bench Verified ($+0.22$ peak lift over 20 rounds). Eight ablations (A1--A8) reveal that the minimal working recipe is smaller than our design suggests: retirement and the meta-skill authoring prior are load-bearing, while explicit deduplication (canonicalisation, cover-guard) is subsumed by the meta-skill itself. A non-divergence proposition shows that bounded cap and retirement threshold together prevent expected performance from drifting below the no-skills floor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ratchet，一种让冻结LLM自主管理技能库的循环框架，通过淘汰、容量限制、元技能指导和模式标准化四种机制，在MBPP+和SWE-bench上显著提升性能，验证了技能生命周期管理而非技能创作才是瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明，LLM自主编写的技能相比无技能基线性能提升为0%，而人工编写的技能可提升16.2%，说明瓶颈在于技能的生命周期管理而非技能创作本身。
AI.method: 提出Ratchet单智能体循环框架，包含四种卫生机制：结果驱动的技能淘汰、有界活跃容量上限、元技能创作指导、模式标准化。LLM负责编写、检索、筛选和淘汰自己的自然语言技能。
AI.result: 在MBPP+ hard-100上，pass@1从0.258提升至0.584（峰值0.658）；在SWE-bench Verified上，20轮内峰值提升0.22。消融实验表明淘汰机制和元技能创作指导是关键组件。
AI.conclusion: 技能生命周期管理是LLM技能学习的关键瓶颈，Ratchet通过简单的管理机制即可实现显著性能提升，且理论证明有界容量和淘汰阈值可防止性能低于无技能基线。
idea_en: A lifecycle management system for LLM-generated skill libraries that autonomously writes, retrieves, curates, and retires natural-language skills without weight updates
An outcome-driven retirement mechanism that automatically removes underperforming skills from an LLM's skill library based on execution results
A bounded active-cap system that limits the number of active skills in an LLM agent's library to prevent performance drift
A meta-skill authoring guidance mechanism that generates higher-level instructions for writing better skills
A pattern canonicalization technique for deduplication and standardization of similar skills in the library
A non-divergence proof framework ensuring bounded cap and retirement threshold prevent expected performance from falling below the no-skills baseline
idea_ch: 一种无需权重更新的LLM技能库全生命周期管理系统，实现自然语言技能的自动编写、检索、筛选和淘汰

有界活跃容量上限系统，限制LLM智能体技能库中的活跃技能数量以防止性能漂移

模式标准化技术，对技能库中相似技能进行去重和标准化处理
非发散性证明框架，确保有界容量和淘汰阈值共同防止预期性能低于无技能基线

title: IdleSpec: Exploiting Idle Time via Speculative Planning for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents solve complex tasks by leveraging multi-step reasoning with iterative tool calls and environment interactions, which incur idle time while waiting for observations. Despite the prevalence of idle time in most agentic scenarios, existing works treat it as an unavoidable overhead or propose restricted solutions that overlook varying computational budgets across different tool calls and future observation uncertainty, thereby leading to suboptimal utilization of idle time. In this paper, we introduce IdleSpec, a scalable and generic inference approach that leverages idle-time computation to improve agent performance while minimizing latency overhead. Specifically, IdleSpec iteratively generates plan candidates during idle periods and, once observations become available, aggregates them to guide the next reasoning step. For effective plan generation under observation uncertainty, IdleSpec samples between complementary drafting strategies (i.e., progressive and recovery) from a learned distribution that is updated via posterior feedback. Our experiments demonstrate that IdleSpec significantly improves agent performance in various agentic scenarios by effectively utilizing idle time. In particular, on the GAIA and FRAMES, IdleSpec achieves 55.6% average accuracy with Gemini-2.5-Flash, surpassing the vanilla baseline without idle-time usage by 5.1%. Furthermore, for MLE-Bench, which involves substantial delay from code executions, IdleSpec achieves performance gains of up to 9.1% on the Any Medal rate, highlighting its generalizability to long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: IdleSpec利用LLM智能体在等待环境反馈时的空闲时间，通过迭代生成并聚合候选规划来提升任务性能，同时最小化延迟开销。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体在等待工具调用和环境交互反馈时存在大量空闲时间，但现有工作要么将其视为不可避免的开销，要么提出受限于计算预算和未来观测不确定性的方案，导致空闲时间利用不充分。
AI.method: IdleSpec在空闲期间迭代生成多个规划候选，当观测结果返回后聚合这些候选以指导下一步推理。针对观测不确定性，采用渐进式和恢复式两种互补起草策略，并通过后验反馈更新学习到的分布来在两者之间采样。
AI.result: 在GAIA和FRAMES上，IdleSpec搭配Gemini-2.5-Flash平均准确率达55.6%，超越基线5.1%；在MLE-Bench上，Any Medal率提升达9.1%。
AI.conclusion: IdleSpec是一种可扩展且通用的推理方法，能有效利用空闲计算提升智能体性能，适用于各种长时间跨度的智能体任务。
idea_en: Method for iterative plan candidate generation and aggregation during idle periods in LLM-based agent systems to improve task performance without latency overhead.
System utilizing complementary drafting strategies (progressive and recovery) with a learned distribution updated via posterior feedback for plan generation under observation uncertainty.
Idle-time computation framework for LLM agents that samples between multiple drafting strategies from a posterior-feedback-updated distribution to optimize plan candidate quality.
idea_ch: 一种在LLM智能体系统空闲期间迭代生成并聚合规划候选的方法，在不增加延迟开销的情况下提升任务性能。
利用渐进式和恢复式两种互补起草策略的系统，通过后验反馈更新学习分布，应对观测不确定性下的规划生成。
基于后验反馈更新分布的多种起草策略间采样的空闲计算框架，用于优化LLM智能体的规划候选质量。

title: ST-SimDiff: Balancing Spatiotemporal Similarity and Difference for Efficient Video Understanding with MLLMs
comment: Accepted by ICLR 2026
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) face significant computational overhead when processing long videos due to the massive number of visual tokens required. To improve efficiency, existing methods primarily reduce redundancy by pruning or merging tokens based on importance or similarity. However, these approaches largely overlook a critical dimension of video content, i.e., changes and turning points, and they lack a collaborative model for spatio-temporal relationships. To address this, we propose a new perspective: similarity is for identifying redundancy, while difference is for capturing key events. Based on this, we designed a training-free framework named ST-SimDiff. We first construct a spatio-temporal graph from the visual tokens to uniformly model their complex associations. Subsequently, we employ a parallel dual-selection strategy: 1) similarity-based selection uses community detection to retain representative tokens, compressing static information; 2) temporal difference-based selection precisely locates content-changing points to preserve tokens that capture key dynamic shifts. This allows it to preserve both static and dynamic content with a minimal number of tokens. Extensive experiments show our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches while substantially reducing computational costs. Our code is available in https://github.com/bingjunluo/ST-SimDiff.

AI.tldr: 提出ST-SimDiff框架，通过时空图建模和并行双选策略（基于相似性的社区检测保留静态代表token + 基于时序差异检测关键事件保留动态token），实现无需训练的长视频高效处理。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs处理长视频时视觉token过多导致计算开销大，已有的剪枝/合并方法仅关注重要性或相似性，忽略了视频内容变化和转折点这一关键维度，且缺乏对时空关系的协同建模。
AI.method: 1) 从视觉token构建时空图统一建模复杂关联；2) 并行双选策略：相似性选择利用社区检测保留代表性token压缩静态信息，时序差异选择精确定位内容变化点保留关键动态token。
AI.result: 在多个基准上显著优于现有方法，同时大幅降低计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 相似性识别冗余、差异性捕捉关键事件的新视角有效，无需训练即可实现高效的长视频处理。
idea_en: A training-free framework for MLLM video token reduction that constructs a spatio-temporal graph from visual tokens and employs parallel dual-selection strategy combining similarity-based community detection and temporal difference-based detection.
A method for video token compression using community detection on spatio-temporal graphs to retain representative tokens for static information compression.
A temporal difference-based token selection mechanism that precisely locates content-changing points in video to preserve tokens capturing key dynamic shifts.
A spatio-temporal graph construction approach for uniformly modeling complex associations among visual tokens in long video processing.
idea_ch: 一种基于时空图构建与并行双选策略的MLLM视频token无需训练压缩框架，同时利用社区检测保留静态代表token和时序差异检测保留关键动态token
一种在视频token压缩中利用社区检测识别代表性token以压缩静态信息的方法
一种基于时序差异的视频内容变化点精确定位机制，用于保留捕捉关键动态变化的token
一种用于长视频处理中视觉token复杂关联统一建模的时空图构建方法

title: Adapting the Interface, Not the Model: Runtime Harness Adaptation for Deterministic LLM Agents
comment: Work in progress
summary: LLM agents are shaped not only by their language models, but also by the runtime harness that mediates observation, tool use, action execution, feedback interpretation, and trajectory control. While existing agent adaptation methods mainly update model parameters, many failures in deterministic, rule-governed domains stem from mismatches at the model--environment interface. We propose Life-Harness, a lifecycle-aware runtime harness that improves frozen LLM agents without changing model weights or evaluation environments. Life-Harness evolves from training trajectories by converting recurring interaction failures into reusable interventions across environment contracts, procedural skills, action realization, and trajectory regulation, and remains fixed during held-out evaluation. On seven deterministic environments from $τ$-bench, $τ^2$-bench, and AgentBench, Life-Harness improves 116 out of 126 model--environment settings across 18 model backbones, with an average relative improvement of 88.5%. Harnesses evolved only from Qwen3-4B-Instruct trajectories transfer to 17 other models, showing that Life-Harness captures reusable environment-side structure rather than model-specific behavior. These results position runtime interface adaptation as a complementary alternative to model-centric agent training. Code is available at GitHub.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Life-Harness，一种生命周期感知的运行时空壳（runtime harness），通过在不改变模型权重或评估环境的前提下，将训练轨迹中的重复交互失败转化为可复用的干预措施，显著提升冻结LLM智能体在确定性规则驱动领域的性能，在126个模型-环境设置中平均提升88.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体主要在模型参数层面进行适配，但许多失败源于模型-环境接口的错配（如观测、工具使用、动作执行、反馈解析等），而非模型能力不足。本文旨在通过改进运行时空壳而非模型本身来解决这类接口失配问题。
AI.method: Life-Harness是一个生命周期感知的运行时空壳，从训练轨迹中学习，将重复发生的交互失败转化为四类可复用的干预措施：环境契约（environment contracts）、程序化技能（procedural skills）、动作实现（action realization）和轨迹调控（trajectory regulation）。在评估阶段，harness固定不变，不改变模型权重或评估环境。
AI.result: 在τ-bench、τ²-bench和AgentBench的7个确定性环境中，覆盖18个模型骨干的126个模型-环境设置中，116个获得提升，平均相对提升88.5%。仅从Qwen3-4B-Instruct轨迹演化出的harness可迁移至其他17个模型。
AI.conclusion: 运行时空壳的界面适配可以作为模型中心式智能体训练的一种互补替代方案，捕获可复用的环境侧结构而非模型特定行为，具有良好的跨模型迁移性。
idea_en: A lifecycle-aware runtime harness system that converts recurring interaction failures from LLM agent trajectories into reusable intervention modules across four categories: environment contracts, procedural skills, action realization, and trajectory regulation.

A method for improving frozen LLM agents by evolving runtime harness from training trajectories without modifying model weights or evaluation environments, enabling cross-model transfer of learned harness interventions.

An environment-side adaptation technique that captures reusable structure from model-environment mismatches in deterministic, rule-governed domains, allowing harnesses evolved from a small model (Qwen3-4B) to transfer to larger and different model backbones.

A runtime interface adaptation framework positioned as a complementary alternative to model-centric agent training, where the harness mediates observation, tool use, action execution, feedback interpretation, and trajectory control.

title: Measuring Cross-Modal Synergy: A Benchmark for VLM Explainability
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) map complex visual inputs to semantic spaces, but interpreting the cross-modal reasoning of VLMs currently relies on post-hoc explainers evaluated via unimodal perturbation metrics. We expose a limitation in this paradigm: because multimodal datasets contain language priors and modality biases, VLMs frequently exhibit cross-modal redundancy, allowing them to answer visual queries using text alone. Consequently, unimodal metrics penalize faithful explainers, triggering an evaluation collapse where visual and textual rankings fundamentally contradict each other. %(Kendall's $τ= -0.06$). To resolve this, we introduce Synergistic Faithfulness ($\mathcal{F}_{syn}$), a scalable metric rooted in the Shapley Interaction Index that strictly isolates the joint Harsanyi dividend between modalities, serving as a highly accurate surrogate ($ρ= 0.92$) while achieving a $24\times$ computational speedup. Evaluating 8 distinct XAI methods across 3 VLM architectures and 3 benchmark datasets, reveals that explainers proposed for VLMs heavily over-index on visual salience and significantly underperform adapted attention-based methods in capturing true cross-modal synergy. By decoupling visual plausibility from cross-modal faithfulness, this work provides a rigorous evaluation framework required to safely audit VLM reasoning in high-stakes deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有的VLM解释器评估方法存在缺陷——由于多模态数据中的语言先验和模态偏差，单模态评估指标会惩罚忠实的解释器，导致评估崩溃。提出基于Shapley交互指数的协同忠实度度量F_syn，能严格隔离模态间的联合贡献，计算速度提升24倍，相关性达0.92。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM解释器依赖事后解释方法，并通过单模态扰动指标评估，但多模态数据中存在语言先验和模态偏差，导致VLMs存在跨模态冗余，即模型可仅凭文本回答视觉问题。这使得单模态指标惩罚忠实的解释器，出现视觉排名与文本排名相互矛盾的评估崩溃现象。
AI.method: 提出Synergistic Faithfulness (F_syn)度量，基于Shapley Interaction Index严格隔离模态间的联合Harsanyi红利，作为跨模态协同的精确代理指标，同时实现24倍计算加速。
AI.result: 在3种VLM架构、3个基准数据集上评估8种XAI方法，发现专门为VLM设计的解释器过度依赖视觉显著性，而改编的注意力机制方法在捕获真实跨模态协同方面表现更优。F_syn与真实协同相关性达0.92，Kendall tau为-0.06（显示传统单模态指标的矛盾）。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦视觉合理性与跨模态忠实性，为高风险场景中VLM推理的安全审计提供了严格的评估框架。
idea_en: A cross-modal faithfulness evaluation metric (Synergistic Faithfulness, F_syn) based on Shapley Interaction Index that strictly isolates the joint Harsanyi dividend between visual and textual modalities for VLM explanation auditing.
A method to detect and resolve evaluation collapse in VLM interpretability assessment by decoupling unimodal plausibility from cross-modal synergistic faithfulness.
A computational acceleration technique (24x speedup) for Shapley-based interaction measurement between modalities in vision-language models.
A systematic framework for identifying cross-modal redundancy in VLMs caused by language priors and modality biases in multimodal datasets.

title: LLM-Metrics: Measuring Research Impact Through Large Language Model Memory
comment: 25pages, 5figures
summary: Citation counts remain the dominant metric for assessing research impact, yet they suffer from well-documented limitations: temporal lag, disciplinary bias, and Matthew effects. Here we propose LLM-Metrics, a research-impact assessment metric derived from the parametric memory of large language models (LLMs). The central hypothesis is that high-impact papers receive greater exposure in the academic community, that this exposure enters LLM training data in textual form, and that models consequently form stronger parametric memory of these papers. We designed four types of multiple-choice probes, covering title recognition, author recognition, method recognition, and venue recognition, and evaluated 549 computer science papers published in 2023-2024 across 17 LLMs spanning 0.5B to 72B parameters from six vendors. Of the 17 models, 15 produced positive predictions, 9 of which were significant at p less than 0.05, with an overall Spearman correlation of rho = 0.1495 and p = 0.0004 against citation counts. Three additional findings support the proposed mechanism. First, the predictive signal was stronger for 2024 papers, rho = 0.1880, whose citation counts were near zero at model-training time, reducing the plausibility of a simple reverse-causality explanation. Second, author-recognition probes showed the strongest discriminative power, consistent with an exposure-driven memory mechanism. Third, model scale and predictive power were non-monotonic: a 3B-parameter model, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, with rho = 0.1829, outperformed most larger models, supporting a selective-memory hypothesis in which the limited capacity of smaller models can serve as an effective information filter. LLM-Metrics offers a real-time, cross-disciplinary, citation-independent paradigm for research assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM-Metrics，一种基于大语言模型参数记忆的新型研究影响力评估指标，通过设计四种多选题探针测试模型对论文的记忆强度，发现其与引用次数存在显著相关性，尤其在小模型（如Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct）上表现最佳，为研究评估提供了实时、跨学科、不依赖引用的新范式。
AI.motivation: 传统引用指标存在时间滞后、学科偏见和马太效应等局限性，亟需一种新的研究影响力评估方法。
AI.method: 设计四种多选题探针（标题识别、作者识别、方法识别、会议/期刊识别），测试17个大语言模型（0.5B-72B参数）对549篇2023-2024年计算机科学论文的记忆强度，并与引用次数进行相关性分析。
AI.result: 15个模型产生正向预测，9个达到显著水平（p<0.05），总体Spearman相关性rho=0.1495（p=0.0004）。2024年论文的预测信号更强（rho=0.1880），作者识别探针区分力最强，3B模型表现优于大多数大型模型。
AI.conclusion: LLM-Metrics提供了一种实时、跨学科、不依赖引用的研究评估新范式，小模型的有限容量可作为一种有效的信息过滤器。
idea_en: A method for assessing research impact by probing parametric memory of large language models using multiple-choice questions covering title, author, method, and venue recognition.
A system that utilizes small-scale LLMs (e.g., 3B parameters) as information filters for research impact prediction, leveraging their limited capacity to selectively memorize high-impact papers.
A real-time, citation-independent research evaluation paradigm based on LLM parametric memory strength, enabling cross-disciplinary assessment without temporal lag.
A multi-probe framework for testing LLM memory of academic papers, including title recognition, author recognition, method recognition, and venue recognition probes.
A technique for measuring the exposure of academic papers in LLM training data by designing forced-choice recognition tasks to quantify parametric memory.

title: Skill Weaving: Efficient LLM Improvement via Modular Skillpacks
comment: Accepted by ACL2026
summary: Large language models increasingly require specialization across diverse domains, yet existing approaches struggle to balance multi-domain capacities with strict memory and inference constraints. In this work, we introduce SkillWeave, a modular improvement framework that enables LLMs to specialize under fixed memory budgets. SkillWeave partitions full capabilities of a general-purpose model into skillpacks -- lightweight, domain-specific delta modules -- that reorganize and refine the model's internal knowledge. For efficient deployment, SkillWeave integrates SkillZip to compress skillpacks into compact and inference-ready format, enabling strong multi-domain performance with low-latency execution. On multi-task and agentic benchmarks, a 9B SkillWeave model outperforms several baselines and even surpasses a 32B monolithic LLM, while achieving up to 4x speedup.

AI.tldr: SkillWeave是一个模块化改进框架，将大语言模型的能力分割为轻量级领域专用增量模块（skillpacks），并通过SkillZip压缩实现高效部署，在固定内存预算下实现多领域专业化，9B模型性能超越32B模型且速度提升4倍。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在多领域专业化时难以平衡多领域能力与严格的内存和推理约束，亟需一种在固定内存预算下实现高效多领域特化的方法。
AI.method: SkillWeave将通用模型的全能力划分为轻量级领域专用增量模块（skillpacks），重组并精炼模型内部知识；同时集成SkillZip将skillpacks压缩为紧凑且可直接推理的格式，实现低延迟执行。
AI.result: 在多任务和智能体基准测试中，9B参数的SkillWeave模型超越了多个基线模型，甚至超过了32B的单体大语言模型，并实现了高达4倍的加速。
AI.conclusion: SkillWeave通过模块化领域特化与高效压缩技术，在固定内存预算下显著提升了大语言模型的多领域专业化能力，验证了轻量级增量模块替代大规模单体模型的可行性。
idea_en: A method for partitioning the full capabilities of a general-purpose LLM into lightweight, domain-specific delta modules (skillpacks) that reorganize and refine internal knowledge, enabling multi-domain specialization under fixed memory budgets.
A compression technique (SkillZip) that compresses skillpacks into a compact, inference-ready format, reducing memory footprint and enabling low-latency execution for multi-domain LLM deployment.
A modular improvement framework that integrates skillpack partitioning and compression to achieve strong multi-domain performance in LLMs while maintaining strict memory and inference constraints.
idea_ch: 一种将通用大语言模型的全部能力划分为轻量级领域专用增量模块（skillpacks）的方法，通过重组和精炼模型内部知识，在固定内存预算下实现多领域专业化。

title: CLORE: Content-Level Optimization for Reasoning Efficiency
comment: 9 pages, 9 figures
summary: Reinforcement learning post-training has improved the reasoning ability of large language models, but often produces unnecessarily long, repetitive, or semantically opaque reasoning traces. Existing efficient reasoning methods mainly regulate response length through explicit budgets or length-aware rewards, leaving intermediate reasoning content weakly supervised. We propose CLORE, a content-level optimization framework that improves reasoning efficiency by editing correct on-policy rollouts. CLORE uses an external augmentation model to delete repetitive segments, illegible or task-irrelevant content, and superfluous reasoning after the solution is established, while preserving the final answer. The resulting augmented--original pairs are optimized with an auxiliary reference-free DPO objective alongside standard policy-gradient training. By restricting augmentation to correct trajectories and performing local deletion, CLORE keeps edited rollouts close to the policy distribution and mitigates off-policy mismatch. Experiments on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B and Qwen2.5-Math-7B across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that CLORE improves the accuracy--efficiency trade-off and remains compatible with GRPO, DAPO, Training Efficient, and ThinkPrune. Content-level analyses further show that CLORE reduces repetitive reasoning, illegible content, and post-answer exploration, supporting content-level supervision as a complementary direction to length-level control.

AI.tldr: CLORE提出了一种内容级优化框架，通过编辑正确的模型生成轨迹（删除重复、模糊、无关内容）来提升大语言模型推理效率，结合辅助的无参考DPO目标与标准策略梯度训练，在保持答案准确性的同时显著减少冗余推理。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习后训练虽然提升了推理能力，但常产生过长、重复、语义不透明的推理轨迹。已有的高效推理方法主要通过显式预算或长度感知奖励来调控响应长度，对中间推理内容的监督较弱。
AI.method: CLORE框架使用外部增强模型删除正确策略 rollout 中的重复片段、难懂内容、任务无关内容以及得出答案后的多余推理，同时保留最终答案。利用增强-原始配对通过辅助的无参考DPO目标与标准策略梯度训练联合优化。仅对正确轨迹进行增强且采用局部删除，使编辑后的rollout接近策略分布，减轻离策略不匹配问题。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B和Qwen2.5-Math-7B上，跨五个数学推理基准实验表明，CLORE改善了准确率-效率权衡，并与GRPO、DAPO、Training Efficient和ThinkPrune兼容。内容级分析显示CLORE减少了重复推理、难懂内容和答案后探索。
AI.conclusion: 内容级监督可作为长度级控制之外的补充方向，有效提升推理效率。
idea_en: A content-level optimization framework (CLORE) that improves reasoning efficiency by editing correct on-policy rollouts, specifically deleting repetitive segments, illegible or task-irrelevant content, and superfluous reasoning after the solution is established while preserving the final answer.

A reference-free DPO objective (Direct Preference Optimization without reference model) combined with standard policy-gradient training for optimizing augmented-original pairs of reasoning trajectories.
A method for local deletion-based augmentation that restricts editing to correct trajectories only, keeping edited rollouts close to the policy distribution and mitigating off-policy mismatch.
Content-level supervision technique that reduces repetitive reasoning, illegible content, and post-answer exploration in large language model reasoning traces.

title: Towards a compositional semantics for quantitative confidence assessment in assurance arguments
comment: Accepted to the 21st European Dependable Computing Conference (EDCC 2026), Canterbury, UK
summary: Assurance arguments provide a clear and structured way to explain why stakeholders should trust that a system satisfies certain properties, yet widely used notations, e.g.Goal Structuring Notation (GSN), typically lack an operational semantics for deriving assurance confidence. Existing approaches address structure and soundness but largely reason over truth values, not over confidence in the justification of claims. Subjective Logic (SL) offers a calculus of belief, disbelief, and uncertainty with operators for combining opinions, enabling confidence propagation under incomplete, conflicting, or subjective evidence. However, existing SL-based approaches do not provide a uniform, compositional semantics that covers all argument elements and relations to enable overall confidence assessment. We propose a confidence semantics that represents argument elements as SL opinions and maps relations between elements to SL operators modelling how confidence flows, effectively turning the argument into an analyzable confidence network. The approach provides explicit warrants, principled handling of context, preserved provenance, and compatibility with GSN, along with practical guidance using an exemplary assurance confidence assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于主观逻辑的置信语义框架，将论证结构转化为可分析的置信网络，支持对系统保证论证的置信度量化评估。
AI.motivation: 现有保证论证符号（如GSN）缺乏操作语义来推导置信度；现有方法多推理真值而非置信度；基于主观逻辑的方法缺乏统一的组合语义覆盖所有论证元素和关系。
AI.method: 将论证元素表示为SL意见（belief/disbelief/uncertainty），将元素间关系映射为SL算子，构建置信网络；提供显式 warrants、上下文处理、溯源保持和GSN兼容性。
AI.result: 提出了一个完整的置信语义框架，能对保证论证进行组合式置信度评估，并通过示例展示了实际应用。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了保证论证中置信度的形式化量化评估，兼顾了结构化、可追溯性和与现有标准（GSN）的兼容性。
idea_en: A method for converting assurance argument structures (e.g., GSN) into analyzable confidence networks by representing argument elements as Subjective Logic (SL) opinions and mapping inter-element relations to SL operators.
A compositional semantics framework that propagates confidence (belief/disbelief/uncertainty) across argument hierarchies using SL calculus, enabling quantified overall confidence assessment.
An explicit warrant mechanism that links evidence-based confidence to argument claims through SL operators, preserving provenance and handling context dependency.
A system for principled handling of context in assurance arguments by modeling contextual factors as SL opinions that modulate confidence propagation.
A confidence assessment tool compatible with GSN notation that transforms graphical argument structures into computable confidence models using SL operations.
idea_ch: 一种将保证论证结构（如GSN）转化为可分析置信网络的方法，通过将论证元素表示为主观逻辑意见，并将元素间关系映射为SL算子。
一种组合语义框架，利用主观逻辑演算在论证层级间传播置信度（信念/不信任/不确定性），实现量化整体置信度评估。
一种显式论证机制，通过SL算子将基于证据的置信度与论证主张相链接，保持溯源并处理上下文依赖。
一种在保证论证中原则性处理上下文的系统，通过将上下文因素建模为调节置信传播的SL意见。
一种兼容GSN符号的置信评估工具，将图形化论证结构通过SL运算转换为可计算的置信模型。

title: SGR-Bench: Benchmarking Search Agents on State-Gated Retrieval
comment: Work in Progress. 23 pages, 7 figures, preprint
summary: Recent advances in large language models and tool-using agents have expanded the range of benchmarked web tasks. Yet an important class of specialized retrieval tasks remains undercharacterized. On many specialized data-retrieval websites, answer-bearing evidence becomes accessible only after establishing the correct site-specific retrieval state through filters, views, hierarchies, or scopes. We term this capability state-gated retrieval (SGR). We introduce SGR-Bench, a benchmark for this setting containing 100 expert-curated tasks spanning six source families and 12 public data ecosystems. Each task requires discovering the appropriate website and configuring its site-specific retrieval state to produce a structured answer. SGR-Bench pairs constraint-guided and goal-oriented formulations of the same underlying problems, enabling controlled comparisons between explicit and implicit guidance for state-gated retrieval. We evaluate eight CLI-based agentic LLM systems and three commercial search-agent products. On SGR-Bench, the strongest system reaches only 66.18% item-level F1, while row-level F1 remains much lower. A manual audit of 156 analyzable failed CLI trajectories shows why: agents often reach a relevant web source, but establish the wrong site-specific retrieval state. Retrieval-scope drift (37.2%) and criterion mismatch (27.6%) dominate, whereas final answer composition accounts for only 10.3%. The dataset and single-case evaluation instructions are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/PKUAIWeb/SGR-BENCH.

AI.tldr: 本文提出状态门控检索（SGR）概念，并构建SGR-Bench基准测试，包含100个专家级任务，评估LLM代理在需配置网站特定检索状态才能获取答案的复杂数据检索场景中的表现。最强系统仅达66.18% F1，主要失败原因是检索范围漂移（37.2%）和条件不匹配（27.6%）。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型和工具代理基准测试多集中于通用网页任务，但忽略了需要先配置网站特定检索状态（如过滤器、视图、层级、范围）才能获取答案的专业数据检索场景，这类能力尚未被充分表征和评估。
AI.method: 构建SGR-Bench基准测试，包含100个专家精选任务，涵盖6个源家族和12个公共数据生态系统。每个任务要求代理发现正确网站并配置其站点特定检索状态以生成结构化答案。采用约束引导和目标导向两种问题形式化方案，评估8个基于CLI的智能体LLM系统和3个商业搜索代理产品。
AI.result: 最强系统在SGR-Bench上项目级F1仅达66.18%，行级F1更低。对156个可分析的失败轨迹进行手工审计，发现代理常能到达相关网页源但错误配置了站点特定检索状态，其中检索范围漂移占37.2%，条件不匹配占27.6%，最终答案组合仅占10.3%。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM代理在状态门控检索任务上表现不足，主要瓶颈不在于定位信息源，而在于正确配置网站特定的检索状态（检索范围漂移和条件不匹配是主要失败原因），这为后续改进提供了明确方向。
idea_en: State-gated retrieval (SGR) framework: A novel method for characterizing web retrieval tasks where answer-bearing evidence becomes accessible only after establishing the correct site-specific retrieval state through filters, views, hierarchies, or scopes.

SGR-Bench benchmark: A systematic benchmark with 100 expert-curated tasks spanning multiple data ecosystems, specifically designed to evaluate LLM agents' ability to configure site-specific retrieval states for specialized data retrieval.

Dual-formulation task design: A method of pairing constraint-guided and goal-oriented formulations of the same retrieval problems, enabling controlled comparisons between explicit and implicit guidance for state-gated retrieval.

Retrieval-scope drift analysis methodology: A diagnostic framework for categorizing agent failures in state-gated retrieval, identifying retrieval-scope drift (37.2%) and criterion mismatch (27.6%) as dominant failure modes distinct from final answer composition (10.3%).
idea_ch: 状态门控检索（SGR）框架：一种表征网页检索任务的新方法，其中包含答案的证据仅能通过正确设置网站特定的检索状态（过滤器、视图、层级或范围）才能访问。
SGR-Bench基准测试：一个包含100个专家精选任务、覆盖多个数据生态系统的系统化基准，专门设计用于评估LLM代理配置网站特定检索状态以完成专业数据检索的能力。
双形式化任务设计方法：将同一检索问题配以约束引导和目标导向两种形式化方案，实现对状态门控检索中显式与隐式引导的受控比较。
检索范围漂移分析方法：一种诊断代理在状态门控检索中失败模式的分类框架，识别出检索范围漂移（37.2%）和条件不匹配（27.6%）为主要失败模式，区别于最终答案组合问题（10.3%）。

title: Evaluating Large Language Models as Live Strategic Agents: Provider Performance, Hybrid Decomposition, and Operational Gaps in Timed Risk Play
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures. Code and tracked notes: https://github.com/hcekne/risk-game . Public runtime artifact index: https://github.com/hcekne/risk-game/blob/main/docs/article-plans/public_experiment_artifacts.md
summary: Static benchmarks capture only part of how large language models behave in practice. Real systems place models inside repeated loops with time limits, formatting constraints, and failure modes. We study this setting in a timed multi-phase Risk environment with explicit victory targets and repeated planning and execution cycles. In a replicated 32-game cross-provider championship under frozen rules, gemini-3.1-pro-preview won 20 of 32 games against gpt-5.1, claude-opus-4-7, and kimi-k2.6, and the pooled winner distribution differs strongly from an equal-strength null (p approx 1.5 x 10^-5). We then separate planning from execution by standardizing execution on a cheaper Gemini Flash scaffold. Under this design, a pooled 32-game planner bakeoff is consistent with near-equality (p approx 0.821), which indicates that much of the earlier provider spread came from end-to-end system behavior rather than planning alone. To study mechanism, we analyze saved planning and execution traces from the provider championship. Gemini refers to the terminal objective far more often than the other models and increases that focus as victory approaches. Gemini also converts more turns into deep conquest chains, even though it is not the cleanest runtime. These results show that live-agent performance depends on objective tracking, execution conversion, cost, and runtime reliability, and they support evaluating LLMs as components in bounded workflows rather than as isolated benchmark respondents.

AI.tldr: 本文通过定时多阶段Risk环境中的32场循环赛，测试了多个大语言模型在反复循环、时间限制和失败模式下的实际表现。Gemini-3.1-pro-preview在32场中赢得20场，远超其他模型。进一步将规划与执行分离后，模型间的差距缩小，表明端到端系统行为比单纯规划能力更能解释性能差异。Gemini更频繁地关注终局目标并在接近胜利时增强聚焦，同时更善于将回合转化为深度征服链。
AI.motivation: 静态基准测试只能反映大语言模型在孤立环境中的表现，无法捕捉模型在实际系统中反复循环、有时间限制、有格式约束和失败模式下的行为。作者希望探索LLM在受限工作流中的真实性能差异及其机制。
AI.method: 设计了一个定时多阶段Risk环境，设定明确的胜利目标和重复的规划与执行循环。跨提供商进行32场冷冻规则下的锦标赛（Gemini-3.1-pro-preview vs gpt-5.1, claude-opus-4-7, kimi-k2.6）。然后通过标准化执行（使用更便宜的Gemini Flash支架）将规划与执行解耦，再进行32场规划器竞赛。最后对保存的规划和执行痕迹进行分析。
AI.result: Gemini-3.1-pro-preview在32场中赢得20场，胜率显著偏离均等假设（p≈1.5×10⁻⁵）。规划与执行分离后，32场规划器竞赛结果接近均等（p≈0.821），说明早期差异主要来自端到端系统行为而非规划能力。Gemini比其他模型更频繁地引用终局目标，且随着胜利临近这一聚焦增强；Gemini还能将更多回合转化为深度征服链。
AI.conclusion: 实时代理性能取决于目标追踪能力、执行转化率、成本和运行时可靠性。评估LLM应将其置于有界工作流中，而非作为孤立的基准测试受访者。
idea_en: A method for evaluating large language models as components in bounded, time-limited, multi-phase workflows rather than as isolated benchmark respondents, using repeated planning-execution cycles with explicit victory targets.

A system architecture that separates planning from execution in multi-agent environments by standardizing execution on a cheaper scaffold (e.g., Gemini Flash), enabling isolated assessment of planning capability.

A technique for measuring objective tracking focus in LLMs during live-agent gameplay by analyzing the frequency of terminal objective references in planning traces, with dynamic adjustment as victory approaches.
A method for converting agent execution turns into deep conquest chains by optimizing objective prioritization and execution conversion efficiency in real-time strategy environments.

A championship-style evaluation framework for LLMs under frozen rules with multiple providers, including statistical testing (p-value analysis) to distinguish provider performance from equal-strength null hypotheses.
A mechanism for analyzing saved planning and execution traces to decompose end-to-end system behavior into planning capability, execution reliability, and runtime cost components.
A timed multi-phase Risk environment specifically designed to test LLM behavior under repeated loops, formatting constraints, and failure modes with explicit victory targets.
idea_ch: 一种将大语言模型作为有界、定时、多阶段工作流组件进行评估的方法，取代孤立的基准测试，使用带有明确胜利目标的重复规划-执行循环。
一种在多智能体环境中将规划与执行解耦的系统架构，通过在更便宜的支架（如Gemini Flash）上标准化执行，实现对规划能力的隔离评估。
一种通过分析规划轨迹中终局目标引用的频率来测量LLM在实时游戏中目标追踪聚焦度的技术，并随胜利临近动态调整。
一种通过优化目标优先级和执行转化效率，在实时战略环境中将智能体执行回合转化为深度征服链的方法。
一种在冷冻规则下跨多个提供商的锦标赛式LLM评估框架，包括使用p值分析的统计检验来区分提供商性能与均等零假设。

一种专为测试LLM在重复循环、格式约束和失败模式下行为而设计的定时多阶段Risk环境，带有明确的胜利目标。

title: Unlocking Proactivity in Task-Oriented Dialogue
summary: Proactive task-oriented dialogue (TOD), such as outbound sales, demands a persuasive agent that actively probes the user's concerns and steers the conversation toward acceptance within a bounded number of turns. Yet post-trained LLMs are inherently conservative, and reward-shaping RL (e.g., GRPO) struggles since it only re-weights what an already passive policy samples. We show that conditioning on the user's latent concerns unlocks proactive capability that no amount of sampling can undermine, establishing these concerns as a pivotal training-time signal. To operationalize this finding, we build the \textbf{Cognitive User Simulator}, which models each user as a stratified persona comprising observable external traits and hidden internal concerns. The simulator produces faithful and diverse interactions, while emitting per-turn state dynamics that track persuasion progress. We then introduce \textbf{Simulator-Induced Asymmetric-View Policy Optimization}, which converts the modeled concerns and the simulation state transition into complementary training objectives: (1) \emph{Asymmetric On-Policy Self-Distillation} that transfers concern-aware behavior from a privileged view of the same policy into its deployable, conversation-only view; and (2) \emph{State-Transition Policy Refinement} ...

AI.tldr: 提出认知用户模拟器与模拟器诱导的非对称视角策略优化，通过在训练中引入用户潜在关切信号，增强任务导向对话系统的主动说服能力。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练LLM在主动任务导向对话中表现保守，奖励塑形强化学习仅能对已有被动策略的采样进行重加权，无法从根本上激发出主动能力。
AI.method: 1. 构建认知用户模拟器，将用户建模为包含可观察外部特质和隐藏内部关切的层次化人设，并输出每轮状态转换追踪说服进度。2. 提出模拟器诱导的非对称视角策略优化，包含：非对称在线自我蒸馏（将关切感知行为从特权视角迁移至可部署的纯对话视角）和状态转换策略优化两个互补训练目标。
AI.result: 通过引入用户潜在关切作为训练信号，显著提升了对话系统的主动说服能力，证明了关切信号的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 用户潜在关切是训练主动任务导向对话系统的关键信号，认知用户模拟器与非对称视角优化方法有效释放了模型的主动能力。
idea_en: A cognitive user simulator that models users as stratified personas with observable external traits and hidden internal concerns, generating faithful and diverse interactions while tracking persuasion progress via per-turn state dynamics.

An asymmetric on-policy self-distillation method that transfers concern-aware behavior from a privileged view of a policy into its deployable conversation-only view, enabling proactive dialogue without requiring access to user internal states during inference.
A state-transition policy refinement framework that converts modeled user concerns and simulation state transitions into complementary training objectives for proactive task-oriented dialogue.

A training-time signal conditioning method that uses user latent concerns to unlock proactive capabilities in LLM-based dialogue systems, establishing concerns as pivotal supervisory signals beyond traditional reward shaping.
idea_ch: 一种认知用户模拟器，将用户建模为包含可观察外部特质和隐藏内部关切的层次化人设，通过每轮状态动态追踪说服进度，生成忠实且多样化的交互。
一种非对称在线自我蒸馏方法，将关切感知行为从策略的特权视角迁移至可部署的纯对话视角，在不依赖用户内部状态的情况下实现主动对话。
一种状态转换策略优化框架，将建模的用户关切与模拟状态转换转化为互补的训练目标，用于主动任务导向对话。
一种基于用户潜在关切的训练信号条件化方法，在基于LLM的对话系统中解锁主动能力，将关切确立为超越传统奖励塑形的关键监督信号。

title: SciCore-Mol: Augmenting Large Language Models with Pluggable Molecular Cognition Modules
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Preprint
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are central to the one-for-all intelligent paradigm, but they face a fundamental challenge when dealing with heterogeneous scientific data such as molecules: the inherent gap between discrete linguistic symbols and topological molecular or continuous reaction data leads to significant information loss and semantic noise in text-based reasoning. We propose SciCore-Mol, a modular framework that bridges this gap through three deeply integrated pluggable cognitive modules: a topology-aware perception module, a latent diffusion-based molecular generation module, and a reaction-aware reasoning module. Each module is coupled to the LLM backbone through learned representation interfaces, enabling richer information exchange than is possible with text-only tool feedback. Our experiments on diverse chemical tasks demonstrate that SciCore-Mol achieves strong comprehensive performance across molecular understanding, generation, reaction prediction, and general chemistry knowledge, with an 8B-parameter open-source system that is competitive with and in several dimensions surpasses proprietary large models. This work provides a systematic blueprint for equipping LLMs with scientific expertise through decoupled, pluggable, and flexibly orchestrated modules, with direct implications for drug design, chemical synthesis, and broader scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: SciCore-Mol提出了一种模块化框架，通过三个可插拔认知模块（拓扑感知、潜在扩散分子生成、反应感知推理）弥合LLM与异构科学数据（如分子）之间的语义鸿沟，在分子理解、生成、反应预测等任务上表现优异，8B参数开源系统在多项指标上超越专有大模型。
AI.motivation: LLM处理异构科学数据（如分子）时，离散语言符号与拓扑分子/连续反应数据之间存在固有鸿沟，导致信息丢失和语义噪声，传统的纯文本工具反馈无法有效解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出SciCore-Mol模块化框架，包含三个深度集成的可插拔认知模块：(1) 拓扑感知感知模块，处理分子结构信息；(2) 潜在扩散分子生成模块；(3) 反应感知推理模块。每个模块通过学习的表征接口耦合到LLM骨干网络，实现比纯文本工具反馈更丰富的信息交换。
AI.result: 在多种化学任务上，SciCore-Mol在分子理解、生成、反应预测和通用化学知识方面均表现出色，8B参数开源系统与专有大模型竞争力相当，在多个维度上甚至超越专有模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为通过解耦、可插拔、灵活编排的模块赋予LLM科学专业知识提供了系统性蓝图，对药物设计、化学合成及更广泛的科学发现具有直接影响。
idea_en: A modular framework (SciCore-Mol) with pluggable cognitive modules for LLMs to process heterogeneous scientific data, comprising a topology-aware perception module for molecular structure understanding.
A latent diffusion-based molecular generation module integrated with LLM backbone via learned representation interfaces for continuous molecular data generation.
A reaction-aware reasoning module coupled to LLM through representation interfaces for chemical reaction prediction and reasoning.
A learned representation interface mechanism that bridges LLM textual embeddings with non-textual scientific data representations, enabling richer information exchange beyond text-only tool feedback.

A decoupled, pluggable, and flexibly orchestrated modular architecture for equipping LLMs with specialized scientific expertise across multiple domains (molecular understanding, generation, reaction prediction).
idea_ch: 一种用于LLM处理异构科学数据的模块化框架（SciCore-Mol），包含可插拔认知模块，其中拓扑感知模块用于分子结构理解。
一种基于潜在扩散的分子生成模块，通过学习的表征接口与LLM骨干网络集成，实现连续分子数据的生成。
一种反应感知推理模块，通过表征接口耦合到LLM，用于化学反应预测与推理。
一种学习型表征接口机制，桥接LLM文本嵌入与非文本科学数据表征，实现超越纯文本工具反馈的丰富信息交换。
一种解耦、可插拔、灵活编排的模块化架构，用于赋予LLM跨多个科学领域（分子理解、生成、反应预测）的专业知识。

title: Cross-domain benchmarks reveal when coordinated AI agents improve scientific inference from partial evidence
summary: Scientific evidence often spans instruments, databases, and disciplines, so no single source records the full phenomenon. This makes it difficult to determine when coordinated AI agents add value over simpler scientific workflows. We evaluate this question with a cross-domain benchmark spanning four scientific tasks: mapping molecular structure into musical representations, detecting historical paradigm shifts in science, identifying vector-borne disease emergence, and vetting transiting-exoplanet candidates. Each case uses a frozen evaluation panel, predefined scoring protocols, explicit baselines, ablations or null controls, and stated limitations. The results define three operating regimes. When different disciplines each capture only part of the phenomenon, cross-channel composites improve over single-channel baselines: climate-vector emergence reaches AUROC 0.944 and exoplanet vetting reaches AUROC 0.955. However, the exoplanet workflow is effectively tied with a strong combined-summary baseline, showing that decomposition does not always improve top-line performance. When one signal dominates, as in paradigm-shift detection, coordination mainly improves interpretation and traceability. For molecular sonification, the gain is representational rather than predictive. ScienceClaw x Infinite provides the auditable artifact and provenance layer for this evaluation. The benchmark therefore assigns value to coordination only when the corresponding performance, provenance, or representation claim is supported by explicit comparators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨领域基准测试，评估协调式AI代理相较于简单科学工作流的价值，定义了三种操作模式：跨通道组合提升性能、协调提升可解释性、协调提供表征优势。
AI.motivation: 科学证据常跨仪器、数据库和学科，单一来源无法记录完整现象，难以确定协调式AI代理何时比简单科学工作流更有价值。
AI.method: 构建跨领域基准测试，涵盖分子结构音乐映射、科学范式转变检测、媒介传播疾病识别、系外行星候选体筛选四个任务，使用固定评估面板、预定义评分协议、显式基线和消融对照。
AI.result: 定义了三种操作模式：1) 跨通道组合提升性能（气候媒介疾病AUROC 0.944，系外行星AUROC 0.955）；2) 协调主要提升可解释性和可追溯性；3) 增益在于表征而非预测。
AI.conclusion: 协调式AI代理的价值仅在对应性能、溯源或表征声明有显式比较器支持时成立。
idea_en: A cross-domain benchmark system for evaluating coordinated AI agent workflows vs. single-channel baselines across multiple scientific tasks
An auditable artifact and provenance layer (ScienceClaw x Infinite) for tracking multi-channel scientific AI coordination
A method for detecting when cross-channel composites improve over single-channel baselines in scientific data analysis
A molecular sonification technique that maps molecular structure into musical representations for representational analysis
A paradigm shift detection system in scientific history using coordinated AI analysis of textual and citation data
A vector-borne disease emergence identification method using climate-vector cross-channel data analysis achieving AUROC 0.944
An exoplanet candidate vetting workflow with coordinated multi-channel analysis achieving AUROC 0.955
idea_ch: 一种跨领域基准测试系统，用于评估协调式AI代理工作流与单通道基线的性能对比
基于ScienceClaw x Infinite的可审计工件与溯源层，用于追踪多通道科学AI协调过程
一种检测跨通道组合何时优于单通道基线的科学数据分析方法
将分子结构映射为音乐表示的分子声化技术，用于表征分析
利用AI协调分析文本与引文数据的科学历史范式转变检测系统
基于气候-媒介跨通道数据实现AUROC 0.944的媒介传播疾病识别方法
采用协调多通道分析实现AUROC 0.955的系外行星候选体筛选工作流

title: Evaluation of Pipelines for Data Integration into Knowledge Graphs
summary: Integrating new data into knowledge graphs (KG) typically involves different tasks that are executed within workflows or pipelines There are many possible pipelines for a specific integration problem but there is not yet a general approach to evaluate the overall quality and performance of such pipelines to be able to determine the best choices. We therefore propose a new benchmark KGI-Bench to evaluate integration pipelines that ingest different kinds of input data into an existing KG. We evaluate pipelines by analyzing their output, i.e., the updated KG, with the three complementary quality metrics coverage, correctness and consistency. We also provide benchmark datasets (seed KG, overlapping input data of three formats, reference KG as a ground truth) for the movie domain. To demonstrate the applicability and usefulness of the proposed benchmark, we comparatively evaluate 12 pipelines and analyze their behavior across different input data formats and design choices.

AI.tldr: 提出了KGI-Bench基准，用于评估将新数据集成到知识图谱中的不同管道的质量，通过覆盖率、正确性和一致性三个指标来评测输出KG，并提供了电影领域的基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有知识图谱集成管道众多，但缺乏通用的质量评估方法来比较不同管道的优劣。
AI.method: 提出KGI-Bench基准，通过三个质量指标（覆盖率、正确性、一致性）评估管道输出的更新后KG；提供基准数据集（种子KG、三种格式的输入数据、参考KG作为真实标签），对12种管道进行对比评估。
AI.result: 成功展示了KGI-Bench在评估12种不同管道、分析不同输入数据格式和设计选择对管道行为影响方面的适用性和有用性。
AI.conclusion: KGI-Bench为知识图谱集成管道的质量评估提供了标准化基准，可帮助选择最优管道。
idea_en: A benchmark system KGI-Bench for evaluating knowledge graph integration pipelines using three complementary quality metrics: coverage, correctness, and consistency.
A standardized evaluation methodology that assesses pipeline output (updated KG) rather than analyzing intermediate steps, enabling fair comparison across different pipeline architectures.
A benchmark dataset suite comprising a seed KG, overlapping input data in three formats (structured, semi-structured, unstructured), and a reference KG as ground truth for the movie domain.

A triple-metric quality evaluation framework that jointly measures coverage (completeness of integrated data), correctness (accuracy of integrated facts), and consistency (logical coherence of the updated KG).
idea_ch: 一种用于评估知识图谱集成管道的基准系统KGI-Bench，采用三个互补质量指标：覆盖率、正确性和一致性。
一种标准化评估方法，通过评估管道输出（更新后的KG）而非分析中间步骤，实现对不同管道架构的公平比较。
一套基准数据集组合，包括种子KG、三种格式（结构化、半结构化、非结构化）的重叠输入数据以及作为真实标签的电影领域参考KG。
一种三指标质量评估框架，联合衡量覆盖率（集成数据的完整性）、正确性（集成事实的准确性）和一致性（更新后KG的逻辑连贯性）。

title: Meta-Soft: Leveraging Composable Meta-Tokens for Context-Preserving KV Cache Compression
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures
summary: The KV cache used in large language models has linearly growing time complexity, so LLMs face memory blow-up and reduced decoding efficiency when they process long contexts.Current KV Cache eviction has become an important research direction; however, existing methods based on fixed Soft Tokens (e.g., Judge Q) rely on a static parameter set as the query to evaluate the importance of KV pairs, so they cannot adapt dynamically to different input prompts, and they cannot precisely capture complex and changing task relevance.Also, evicted KV pairs are discarded permanently, so this causes irreversible information loss and context breaks. To address this problem, we propose Meta-Soft, a dynamic compression framework based on probe-driven context integration. Specifically, we build a meta-library with a learnable orthogonal basis matrix $\mathcal{L}$, and we use a selector network with Gumbel-Softmax to produce differentiable sparse combination weights, so we dynamically synthesize the most targeted $k$ Soft Tokens from the input prompt features.We append these Soft Tokens to the end of the input sequence to probe key information. We also introduce an attention-flow based integration mechanism, which redistributes the semantic information of removed tokens into retained tokens, and this keeps the dropped context information effectively.Experiments on multiple datasets show that our method outperforms existing state-of-the-art eviction methods and provides a new solution for KV Cache compression.

AI.tldr: 提出Meta-Soft动态压缩框架，通过学习型正交基矩阵和Gumbel-Softmax选择网络动态合成Soft Token，结合注意力流集成机制重分配被移除token的语义信息，实现更高效的KV Cache压缩。
AI.motivation: 现有KV Cache驱逐方法依赖固定Soft Token（如Judge Q），无法动态适应不同输入提示，也无法精确捕捉复杂变化的任务相关性；且被驱逐的KV对永久丢弃，导致不可逆的信息丢失和上下文断裂。
AI.method: 1) 构建包含可学习正交基矩阵L的元库；2) 使用带Gumbel-Softmax的选择网络生成可微分的稀疏组合权重，从输入提示特征中动态合成最相关的k个Soft Token；3) 将Soft Token附加到输入序列末尾以探测关键信息；4) 引入基于注意力流的集成机制，将移除token的语义信息重新分配到保留的token中。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于现有最先进的驱逐方法，为KV Cache压缩提供了新的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: Meta-Soft通过动态生成Soft Token和注意力流信息集成，有效解决了传统KV Cache驱逐方法适应性差和信息丢失的问题。
idea_en: A dynamic KV cache compression framework using a learnable orthogonal basis matrix as a meta-library, where sparse combination weights are generated via Gumbel-Softmax selector network to synthesize task-adaptive Soft Tokens from input prompt features.
A probe-driven context integration method that appends dynamically synthesized Soft Tokens to the end of input sequences for probing key information in KV cache management.

An attention-flow based information redistribution mechanism that transfers semantic information from evicted tokens to retained tokens, preventing irreversible information loss during KV cache eviction.
A differentiable sparse selection mechanism using Gumbel-Softmax for combining orthogonal basis vectors to generate customized Soft Tokens for KV cache importance evaluation.
idea_ch: 一种基于可学习正交基矩阵元库的动态KV缓存压缩框架，通过Gumbel-Softmax选择网络生成稀疏组合权重，从输入提示特征中合成任务自适应的Soft Token
一种探针驱动的上下文集成方法，将动态合成的Soft Token附加到输入序列末尾，用于探测KV缓存管理中的关键信息
一种基于注意力流的信息重分配机制，将被驱逐token的语义信息转移到保留token中，防止KV缓存驱逐过程中的不可逆信息丢失
一种使用Gumbel-Softmax进行可微分稀疏选择的机制，用于组合正交基向量生成定制化Soft Token以评估KV缓存重要性

title: Scaling Observation-aware Planning in Uncertain Domains
summary: Deciding which sensing capabilities to deploy on an agent in uncertain domains is a fundamental engineering challenge, in which one balances task achievability against the high costs of hardware and processing. This problem has previously been formalized as the Optimal Observability Problem (OOP), based on the well-known Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) model for decision-making. This work studies (sub-)symbolic techniques to scale solving of decidable fragments of the OOP, namely the Sensor Selection Problem (SSP) and the Positional Observability Problem (POP). Besides improving the original approach based on parameter synthesis, we develop a new solving method that identifies sensible observation functions via decomposition of POMDPs, improving performance by 3 and 5 orders of magnitude for instance size and runtime, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在不确定领域中智能体感知能力部署的优化问题，提出了基于POMDP分解的新求解方法，将传感器选择问题和位置可观测性问题的求解性能提升了3-5个数量级。
AI.motivation: 在不确定环境中部署智能体时，需要在任务可实现性与硬件/处理成本之间取得平衡，而现有方法在求解最优可观测性问题时计算开销巨大，难以扩展。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于POMDP分解的新求解方法，通过将POMDP分解为子组件来识别合理的观测函数，并改进了原有的参数合成方法。
AI.result: 在实例规模和运行时间上分别提升了3个和5个数量级的性能改进。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于POMDP分解的求解方法能够显著扩展可求解的OOP片段（SSP和POP），为实际工程中的传感器部署提供了可扩展的解决方案。
idea_en: A method for optimal sensor selection in partially observable environments using POMDP decomposition, where the observation function is identified by decomposing the POMDP into sub-components, achieving 3-5 orders of magnitude improvement in computational efficiency.
A Positional Observability Problem (POP) solving technique that leverages symbolic or sub-symbolic decomposition to determine optimal sensor placement positions for agents in uncertain domains.
A hybrid approach combining parameter synthesis with POMDP decomposition for solving the Sensor Selection Problem (SSP), enabling scalable decision-making about which sensing capabilities to deploy.
idea_ch: 一种基于POMDP分解的部分可观测环境最优传感器选择方法，通过将POMDP分解为子组件来识别观测函数，计算效率提升3-5个数量级
一种利用符号/子符号分解的定位可观测性问题求解技术，用于确定不确定域中智能体传感器的最优部署位置
一种结合参数合成与POMDP分解的混合方法，用于求解传感器选择问题，实现了关于部署哪些感知能力的可扩展决策

title: Epicure: Navigating the Emergent Geometry of Food Ingredient Embeddings
summary: We present Epicure, a family of three sibling skip-gram ingredient embeddings retrained from scratch on a multilingual recipe corpus. We aggregate 4.14M recipes from 11 sources spanning seven languages, English, Chinese, Russian, Vietnamese, Spanish, Turkish, Indonesian, German, and Indian-English, and normalise the raw ingredient strings to 1,790 canonical entries via an LLM-augmented pipeline. A 203,508-edge ingredient-ingredient NPMI graph and an 80,019-edge typed FlavorDB ingredient-compound graph, 2,247 typed compound nodes across 15 categories, seed three Metapath2Vec variants that share architecture and hyperparameters and differ only in the random-walk schema: Cooc walks the co-occurrence graph only, Chem walks the typed compound metapaths only, and Core blends both via injected ingredient-ingredient walks at controlled mixing, placing each model at a distinct point on the chemistry-vs-recipe-context spectrum.

AI.tldr: Epicure是一个从多语种菜谱语料库中重新训练的skip-gram食材嵌入模型家族，包含三种变体（Cooc、Chem、Core），通过整合4.14M条菜谱、LLM增强的标准化pipeline以及食材共现图与FlavorDB化合物图，在化学-食谱语境谱系上探索不同的嵌入策略。
AI.motivation: 现有食材嵌入模型通常仅在单一语言或单一关系（如共现）上训练，缺乏对食材的化学属性（风味化合物）与食谱上下文（共现关系）的融合建模，无法全面捕捉食材的多维语义关联。
AI.method: 1) 从11个来源收集7种语言的4.14M条菜谱；2) 通过LLM增强的pipeline将原始食材字符串标准化为1,790个规范条目；3) 构建203,508条边的食材-食材NPMI共现图和80,019条边的FlavorDB类型化食材-化合物图（2,247个化合物节点，15个类别）；4) 基于上述图结构训练三种Metapath2Vec变体：Cooc（仅共现图）、Chem（仅类型化化合物元路径）、Core（混合两种路径）。
AI.result: 获得了三个位于化学-食谱语境谱系不同位置的食材嵌入模型，能够分别捕捉食材的共现关系、化学组成以及两者的混合信息。
AI.conclusion: 通过多源多语言菜谱数据与化学知识图谱的融合，Epicure展示了在不同粒度上建模食材语义的可行性，为食材表示学习提供了新的多维度思路。
idea_en: A method for normalizing multilingual ingredient names into canonical entries using an LLM-augmented pipeline, enabling consistent ingredient representation across languages
A system for constructing a typed ingredient-compound knowledge graph from FlavorDB with 15 chemical categories to model ingredient chemistry
A Metapath2Vec-based approach using controlled mixing of co-occurrence and chemical compound metapaths to generate ingredient embeddings at different positions on a chemistry-recipe context spectrum
idea_ch: 基于LLM增强pipeline的多语言食材名称标准化方法，将不同语言的原始食材字符串统一映射到规范条目
基于FlavorDB构建类型化食材-化合物知识图谱的系统，涵盖15个化学类别以建模食材的化学属性
一种基于Metapath2Vec的可控混合共现路径与化合物元路径的食材嵌入生成方法，可在化学-食谱语境谱系上调节嵌入位置

title: S2ED: From Story to Executable Descriptions for Consistency-Aware Story Illustration
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted by IEEE ICME 2026
summary: Multi-frame story illustration requires long-horizon coherence beyond single-image text-to-image generation, including narrative decomposition and persistent character identity, layout, and affect across frames. We propose Story-to-Executable Descriptions (S2ED), a training-free, model-agnostic, prompt-layer framework that converts a full story into a sequence of explicit, editable executable descriptions for more consistent rendering. S2ED coordinates three agents to segment the narrative, ground canonical character attributes, and enrich spatial and affective cues, enabling interpretable prompt-carried state propagation and local edits to repair drift without retraining the generator. Experiments on Flintstones and Shakoo Maku show that S2ED improves sequence-level consistency and character fidelity over strong prompting, large-model planning, and a reference training-based method, under both automatic metrics and human judgments. We also deploy S2ED in an end-to-end story-to-storybook system for children's illustrated stories, with a supplementary video.

AI.tldr: 本文提出S2ED框架，通过可执行描述序列（而非自然语言提示）驱动多帧故事插图生成，实现无需训练的、模型无关的叙事一致性与角色身份保持。
AI.motivation: 现有单图像生成模型在多帧故事插图任务中存在叙事连贯性差、角色身份/布局/情感难以跨帧保持一致的问题。
AI.method: 提出S2ED框架，协调三个智能体：1) 叙事分割智能体；2) 角色属性锚定智能体；3) 空间与情感线索丰富智能体。将故事转化为显式、可编辑的可执行描述序列，实现提示层状态传播与局部漂移修复。
AI.result: 在Flintstones和Shakoo Maku数据集上，S2ED在序列级一致性和角色保真度方面优于强提示方法、大模型规划方法和基于参考训练的方法，自动指标和人工判断均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: S2ED提供了一个无需训练、模型无关的提示层框架，有效解决多帧故事插图的长期连贯性问题，并可部署于端到端故事绘本系统。
idea_en: 1. A multi-agent prompt-layer framework (S2ED) that converts full story text into a sequence of explicit, editable executable descriptions for consistent multi-frame story illustration without retraining the generator.
2. A narrative segmentation agent that automatically decomposes a long story into coherent sub-segments for frame-by-frame illustration.
3. A character attribute grounding agent that extracts and maintains canonical character attributes (identity, appearance) across multiple frames in a story.
4. A spatial and affective cue enrichment agent that adds explicit layout and emotion instructions to each frame's description.
5. A prompt-carried state propagation mechanism that transfers character/layout/affect state across frames via executable descriptions, enabling interpretable consistency control.
6. A local drift repair method that allows targeted editing of specific frames' executable descriptions to fix generation errors without affecting other frames or retraining.
idea_ch: 1. 一种多智能体提示层框架（S2ED），将完整故事文本转换为显式、可编辑的可执行描述序列，用于多帧故事插图的一致性生成，无需重新训练生成器。
2. 叙事分割智能体，自动将长故事分解为连贯的子段，逐帧生成插图。
3. 角色属性锚定智能体，跨帧提取并维护角色的规范属性（身份、外观），确保角色一致性。
4. 空间与情感线索丰富智能体，为每一帧描述添加显式的布局和情感指令。
5. 基于提示的状态传播机制，通过可执行描述在帧间传递角色/布局/情感状态，实现可解释的一致性控制。
6. 局部漂移修复方法，允许对特定帧的可执行描述进行定向编辑以修复生成错误，不影响其他帧且无需重新训练。

title: KAPPS: A knowledge-based CPPS Architecture for the Circular Factory
comment: Submitted to Journal of Manufacturing Systems (JMS)
summary: While linear manufacturing relies on homogeneous materials and predefined process sequences, circular manufacturing reintroduces used products with heterogeneous and uncertain conditions. This shift demands manufacturing systems capable of handling variable product states, dynamically reconfigurable processes, and the integration of human and machine knowledge. Conventional manufacturing IT architectures, designed for stable structures and deterministic execution, are unable to meet these requirements, as they cannot adequately represent and manage the uniqueness of individual components at runtime. Following a design science methodology for developing a Cyber Physical Production System for circular manufacturing, we derive 14 requirements from five complementary perspectives. Based on these requirements, we design KAPPS, a knowledge-based architecture that uses an ontology-grounded knowledge graph as a unifying data backbone, combined with a semantic interface layer to enable consistent data and information integration, reasoning, and communication across heterogeneous systems and services, turning the knowledge graph from an integration layer into the factories authoritative write-time state. KAPPS incorporates modules for constraint enforcement and event-driven planning, enabling incremental adaptation of execution plans under uncertainty and human-machine knowledge exchange. The applicability of KAPPS is demonstrated through two implemented use cases: (i) Anomaly detection and learning through knowledge graph mediated services and (ii) runtime constraint enforcement in a modular conveyor system. Subsequently, the architecture is evaluated against the 14 requirements (ed. abstract shortened)

AI.tldr: 本文提出KAPPS，一种基于知识图谱的架构，用于循环制造中的信息物理生产系统，通过本体驱动知识图谱作为统一数据骨干和语义接口层，实现异构系统的数据集成、推理和通信，满足循环制造对动态重构和人机知识融合的需求。
AI.motivation: 传统线性制造依赖均质材料和预定义流程，而循环制造需处理异质、不确定的旧产品，传统制造IT架构无法表示和管理单个组件的独特性，亟需新架构支持可变产品状态、动态可重构流程及人机知识融合。
AI.method: 采用设计科学研究方法论，从五个互补视角推导14项需求，设计KAPPS架构：以本体为基础的知识图谱作为统一数据骨干，结合语义接口层实现数据集成与推理，包含约束强制执行和事件驱动规划模块，支持增量式执行计划自适应和人机知识交换。
AI.result: 通过两个用例验证：1) 基于知识图谱中介服务的异常检测与学习；2) 模块化输送系统中的运行时约束强制执行。并对14项需求进行了评估。
AI.conclusion: KAPPS架构通过将知识图谱从集成层转变为工厂的权威写入时状态，有效解决了循环制造中不确定性和异构性带来的挑战，支持增量式执行计划调整和人机知识交换。
idea_en: A knowledge graph-based Cyber-Physical Production System architecture (KAPPS) for circular manufacturing that uses an ontology-grounded knowledge graph as a unifying data backbone with authoritative write-time state across heterogeneous systems.

A semantic interface layer design enabling consistent data and information integration, reasoning, and communication across heterogeneous manufacturing systems and services using ontology-grounded knowledge representation.
A constraint enforcement module for runtime adaptation of execution plans in circular manufacturing, allowing incremental plan modification under uncertainty.
An event-driven planning mechanism integrated with knowledge graph that enables dynamic reconfiguration of manufacturing processes based on real-time product state information.
A human-machine knowledge exchange framework within circular manufacturing systems, facilitating integration of operator knowledge with automated reasoning through knowledge graph mediation.
An anomaly detection and learning method mediated by knowledge graph services in circular manufacturing environments, enabling identification of unusual product states during remanufacturing.
