title: Compiling Agentic Workflows into LLM Weights: Near-Frontier Quality at Two Orders of Magnitude Less Cost
comment: 19 pages
summary: Agent orchestration frameworks have proliferated, collectively exceeding 290,000 GitHub stars across LangGraph, CrewAI, Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Semantic Kernel, Strands, and LlamaIndex. All follow the same pattern: an external orchestrator above the LLM, injecting instructions and routing decisions every turn. Recent work has shown this architecture is dominated for procedural tasks by simply providing the procedure in a frontier model's system prompt [Dennis et al., 2026a], at the cost of consuming the context window, requiring a frontier model for every conversation, and exposing proprietary procedures to third-party providers. Compiling the procedure into the weights of a small fine-tuned model -- creating a subterranean agent -- should resolve all of these concerns, and prior work (SimpleTOD, FireAct, SynTOD, WorkflowLLM, Agent Lumos) has shown the technique works. Yet developer adoption has overwhelmingly favored orchestration. We identify three perceived barriers and address each empirically across travel booking (14 nodes), Zoom support (14 nodes, product-specific knowledge), and insurance claims (55 nodes, 6 decision hubs).

AI.tldr: 尽管现有的Agent编排框架（如LangGraph、CrewAI等）已获得大量采用，但论文提出通过将程序编译到小型微调模型的权重中（"地下代理"），可解决编排架构中上下文窗口消耗、依赖前沿模型以及暴露专有程序等问题，并实证解决了三项感知障碍。
AI.motivation: 当前的Agent编排框架虽流行（超290,000 GitHub星标），但其架构存在根本性问题：外部编排器在每个轮次注入指令和路由决策，导致消耗上下文窗口、每次对话都需要前沿模型，以及将专有程序暴露给第三方提供商。作者希望解决这些问题，将代理从"编排式"转向"编译到模型权重中"的方式。
AI.method: 论文提出"地下代理"（subterranean agent）方法——将程序直接编译到小型微调模型的权重中，而非通过外部编排器注入指令。识别出开发者采用该方式的三个感知障碍，并通过三个实际业务场景（旅游预订14节点、Zoom支持14节点+产品知识、保险理赔55节点+6个决策枢纽）进行实证验证。
AI.result: 论文在旅游预订、Zoom支持和保险理赔三个场景中实证验证了地下代理方法，证明将程序编译到小型模型权重中的方式可以克服三个感知障碍，在保持性能的同时解决编排架构的上下文窗口消耗、前沿模型依赖和程序暴露问题。
AI.conclusion: 编译式地下代理方法能有效替代当前主流的编排架构，解决其核心缺陷，且在实际业务场景中可行，有望推动开发者从编排式代理转向编译式代理。
idea_en: Method of compiling procedural instructions directly into the weights of a small fine-tuned model (subterranean agent) instead of using external orchestrators, which eliminates context window consumption and dependency on frontier models while protecting proprietary procedures.

Architecture for agent orchestration where routing decisions and instructions are embedded in model weights through fine-tuning, removing the need for an external orchestrator to inject instructions every turn.
System for travel booking agent that compiles 14-node procedures into fine-tuned small model weights, enabling task execution without exposing proprietary business logic to third-party LLM providers.

Method for customer support agent (Zoom support) that encodes both procedural steps and product-specific knowledge into small model weights via fine-tuning, reducing reliance on frontier models for routine support tasks.

Scalable approach for insurance claims processing (55 nodes, 6 decision hubs) using weight-compiled procedural agents, enabling complex multi-decision workflows without consuming context window for instructions.
idea_ch: 将程序指令直接编译到小型微调模型权重中的方法（地下代理），替代外部编排器，消除上下文窗口消耗和对前沿模型的依赖，同时保护专有程序不被第三方提供商获取。
一种代理编排架构，通过微调将路由决策和指令嵌入模型权重，无需外部编排器在每个交互轮次注入指令，降低计算成本和延迟。
旅游预订代理系统，将14节点业务流程编译到微调的小型模型权重中，在不向第三方LLM提供商暴露专有业务逻辑的情况下执行任务。
客户支持代理方法（Zoom支持场景），通过微调将程序步骤和产品特定知识同时编码到小型模型权重中，减少对前沿模型的依赖。
保险理赔处理的可扩展方法（55节点、6个决策枢纽），使用权重编译的程序代理，在不消耗上下文窗口存储指令的情况下实现复杂的多决策工作流。

title: LACO: Adaptive Latent Communication for Collaborative Driving
summary: Collaborative driving aims to improve safety and efficiency by enabling connected vehicles to coordinate under partial observability. Recent approaches have evolved from sharing visual features for perception to exchanging language-based reasoning through foundation models for behavioral coordination. Though communicating in language provides intuitive information, it introduces two challenges: high latency caused by autoregressive decoding and information loss caused by compressing rich internal representations into discrete tokens. To address these challenges, we analyze latent communication in collaborative driving under inherent limitations of multi-agent settings. Our analysis reveals agent identity confusion, where direct fusion of latent states entangles decision representations across vehicles. Motivated by this, we propose LACO, a training-free \textbf{LA}tent \textbf{CO}mmunication paradigm that seamlessly adapts pretrained driving models to collaborative settings. LACO introduces Iterative Latent Deliberation (ILD) for latent reasoning, Cross-Horizon Saliency Attribution (CHSA) for communication-efficient information selection, and Structured Semantic Knowledge Distillation (SSKD) to stabilize ego-centric decision making. Closed-loop experiments in CARLA show that LACO notably reduces communication and inference latency while maintaining strong collaborative driving performance.

AI.tldr: LACO提出了一种无需训练的潜空间通信范式，通过迭代潜空间推理、跨视野显著性归因和结构化语义知识蒸馏，解决了协作驾驶中语言通信的高延迟和信息损失问题。
AI.motivation: 现有协作驾驶方法从共享视觉特征演进到基于大模型的语言推理通信，但语言通信存在两大问题：自回归解码导致的高延迟，以及将丰富内部表示压缩为离散tokens造成的信息损失。
AI.method: 提出LACO范式，包含三个创新组件：1) 迭代潜空间推理(ILD)用于潜空间协作推理；2) 跨视野显著性归因(CHSA)用于通信高效的信息选择；3) 结构化语义知识蒸馏(SSKD)用于稳定以自我为中心的决策。
AI.result: 在CARLA闭环实验中，LACO显著降低了通信和推理延迟，同时保持了强大的协作驾驶性能。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间通信相比语言通信能有效降低延迟并减少信息损失，但需解决多智能体身份混淆问题，LACO通过三种机制实现了高效的协作驾驶。
idea_en: Iterative Latent Deliberation (ILD): A training-free mechanism enabling collaborative reasoning directly in the latent space across multiple vehicles, avoiding the latency of autoregressive language decoding.

Cross-Horizon Saliency Attribution (CHSA): A communication-efficient information selection method that identifies and transmits only the most salient latent features across different temporal horizons, reducing bandwidth while preserving task-critical information.

Structured Semantic Knowledge Distillation (SSKD): A technique to stabilize ego-centric decision making by distilling structured semantic knowledge from multi-agent latent representations, preventing agent identity confusion during latent fusion.

Training-free latent communication paradigm: A method to adapt pretrained driving models to collaborative settings without requiring additional training, enabling seamless integration with existing autonomous driving systems.
Latent space collaborative driving framework addressing agent identity confusion through iterative deliberation and saliency-based selective communication.
idea_ch: 迭代潜空间推理(ILD)：一种无需训练的多车潜空间协作推理机制，直接在高维潜空间中进行推理交互，避免了自回归语言解码带来的高延迟。
跨视野显著性归因(CHSA)：一种通信高效的信息选择方法，通过识别不同时间视野中最显著的潜空间特征进行选择性传输，在降低通信带宽的同时保留任务关键信息。
结构化语义知识蒸馏(SSKD)：一种稳定以自我为中心的决策的技术，通过从多智能体潜表示中蒸馏结构化语义知识，防止潜空间融合时的智能体身份混淆。
无需训练的潜空间通信范式：一种将预训练驾驶模型无缝适配到协作驾驶场景的方法，无需额外训练即可与现有自动驾驶系统集成。
基于迭代精炼和显著性选择性通信的潜空间协作驾驶框架，有效解决了多智能体潜空间融合中的身份混淆问题。

title: Towards Direct Evaluation of Harness Optimizers via Priority Ranking
comment: Preprint. Work in Progress
summary: Harness optimization enables automated agent creation by having an optimizer agent iteratively update the harness of target agents. Despite its success, current studies evaluate optimizers solely by observing target agents' performance gains. This indirect end-improvement evaluation neglects optimizers' actions at intermediate steps, which are often erroneous and hinder agent performance. Therefore, it is unclear whether harness optimization is driven by optimizers' informed update actions or simply trial-and-error. This necessitates direct evaluation of harness optimizers. However, evaluating harness optimizers directly is non-trivial and costly due to the lack of oracle harnesses. To address this, we present a simple, low-cost design to directly evaluate them, namely priority ranking. By asking harness optimizers to rank components (e.g., tools) in a given harness by their potential to improve/hinder agent performance when updated, our design quantifies optimizer ability at the step level without expensive rollouts or manual examination. More importantly, optimizers' ranking performance correlates with their ability to improve agents in actual multi-step harness optimization, establishing priority ranking as a reliable predictor of optimization ability. Priority ranking is enabled by Shor, a collection of 182 human-verified optimization scenarios spanning across domains, designs, and time stages. Codes and data can be found at https://github.com/k59118/Harness_Optimizer_Evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“优先级排序”的低成本方法，用于直接评估智能体（Agent）框架优化器（Harness Optimizer）的性能，通过让优化器对框架中各组件的改进潜力进行排序来量化其能力，避免了传统依赖最终性能的间接评估方式。
AI.motivation: 现有研究仅通过观察目标智能体的性能提升来间接评估优化器，忽略了优化器在中间步骤中的错误操作，无法判断优化效果是来自有依据的更新还是简单的试错，因此需要一种直接、低成本的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出优先级排序方法，让框架优化器对给定框架中的组件（如工具）按其改进或阻碍智能体性能的潜力进行排序，从而在步骤层面量化优化器能力，无需昂贵的实际运行或人工检查。
AI.result: 优化器的排序性能与其在实际多步框架优化中改进智能体的能力存在相关性，验证了优先级排序可作为优化能力的可靠预测指标。同时构建了包含182个人工验证优化场景的Shor数据集。
AI.conclusion: 优先级排序是一种简单、低成本且有效的框架优化器直接评估方法，能够作为优化器实际性能的可靠预测指标，为智能体框架优化研究提供了新的评估范式。
idea_en: A method for directly evaluating harness optimizers using priority ranking, where the optimizer sorts components by their potential impact on agent performance improvement or degradation.
A low-cost evaluation design that quantifies optimizer capability at the step level without requiring expensive rollouts or manual examination.
A priority ranking-based predictor that correlates with actual multi-step harness optimization performance, enabling reliable assessment of optimization ability.
Shor: a collection of 182 human-verified optimization scenarios across domains, designs, and time stages for benchmarking harness optimizers.
idea_ch: 一种基于优先级排序直接评估框架优化器的方法：让优化器对框架组件按其改进或阻碍智能体性能的潜力进行排序，从而量化其步骤级决策能力。
一种低成本评估设计方案：无需昂贵的实际运行或人工检查，即可在步骤层面量化优化器能力，解决了传统间接评估的局限性。
一种基于排序性能的优化能力预测器：通过优化器的排序表现预测其在实际多步框架优化中改进智能体的能力，建立了可靠的评估指标体系。
Shor基准数据集：包含182个人工验证的优化场景，覆盖多领域、多设计、多时间阶段的标准化测试集，用于框架优化器的系统评估与对比。

title: Search-E1: Self-Distillation Drives Self-Evolution in Search-Augmented Reasoning
summary: Post-training has become the dominant recipe for turning a language model into a competent search-augmented reasoning agent. A line of recent work pushes its performance further by adding elaborate machinery on top of this standard pipeline. These augmentations import external supervision from stronger external systems, attach auxiliary modules such as process reward models or retrospective critics, restructure the rollout itself with tree search or multi-stage curricula, or shape the reward with hand-crafted bonuses and penalties. Each addition delivers a measurable gain, but each also inflates the training pipeline and ties the recipe to resources or designs that may not always be available. We take a step back and ask whether any of this machinery is actually necessary, and propose Search-E1, a self-evolution method that lets a search-augmented agent improve through only vanilla GRPO interleaved with offline self-distillation (OFSD). After each GRPO round, the policy rolls out on its own training questions. A token-level forward KL objective then aligns the policy's inference-time distribution to its own distribution under a privileged context that exposes a more efficient sibling trajectory. Despite this simplicity, the procedure naturally provides dense per-step supervision. On seven QA benchmarks, Search-E1 reaches $0.440$ average EM with Qwen2.5-3B, surpassing all open-source baselines at both scales. Code and complete version will be made public soon.

AI.tldr: 提出Search-E1，一种仅使用vanilla GRPO和离线自蒸馏（OFSD）的自我进化方法，无需额外外部监督或复杂模块，即可提升搜索增强推理代理的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练方法通过添加外部监督、辅助模块、树搜索等复杂机制来提升搜索增强推理代理的性能，但这些附加组件使训练流程膨胀且依赖稀缺资源。本文质疑这些复杂机制是否真的必要。
AI.method: Search-E1将vanilla GRPO与离线自蒸馏（OFSD）交替进行。每轮GRPO后，策略在自身训练问题上进行 rollout，然后通过token级前向KL散度，将策略的推理时分布对齐到其在特权上下文（暴露更高效的兄弟轨迹）下的自身分布。
AI.result: 在7个QA基准测试上，Search-E1使用Qwen2.5-3B达到0.440的平均EM分数，超越了同规模所有开源基线。
AI.conclusion: 简单的自我进化方法（仅GRPO+OFSD）即可达到甚至超越复杂后训练管线的性能，证明现有复杂机制并非必要。
idea_en: A self-evolution method for search-augmented agents using vanilla GRPO interleaved with offline self-distillation (OFSD), eliminating the need for external supervision or auxiliary modules.
A token-level forward KL divergence objective that aligns the policy's inference-time distribution to its own distribution under a privileged context exposing a more efficient sibling trajectory.

A training pipeline that interleaves GRPO rounds with offline self-distillation on the policy's own rollouts on training questions, providing dense per-step supervision without external rewards or process reward models.
A privileged context mechanism that exposes efficient sibling trajectories during self-distillation to provide dense per-step supervision signals.
idea_ch: 一种基于vanilla GRPO与离线自蒸馏（OFSD）交替进行的搜索增强代理自我进化方法，无需外部监督或辅助模块。
一种token级前向KL散度目标函数，将策略的推理时分布对齐到其特权上下文（暴露更高效兄弟轨迹）下的自身分布。
一种将GRPO轮次与策略自身训练问题上的离线自蒸馏交替进行的训练管线，无需外部奖励或过程奖励模型即可提供密集的逐步骤监督。
一种特权上下文机制，在自蒸馏过程中暴露更高效的兄弟轨迹，以提供密集的逐步骤监督信号。

title: Meta-Learning for Rapid Adaptation in Reference Tracking of Uncertain Nonlinear Systems
comment: 13 pages
summary: In this paper, we address the problem of reference tracking for uncertain nonlinear systems. Since collecting data from the target system (i.e., the system of interest) is often challenging, our objective is to design optimal controllers using limited target system data. Meta-learning provides a promising paradigm by leveraging offline data from source systems (systems sharing structural similarities with the target system) to accelerate training and enhance control performance. Motivated by this idea, we propose a meta-learning-based control framework that tailors the implicit model-agnostic meta-learning (iMAML) algorithm to the control setting. The framework operates in two phases: an (offline) meta-training phase, where an aggregated representation is learned from source data to capture the shared system dynamics among similar systems, and an (online) meta-adaptation phase, where this representation is fine-tuned on the target system using only a few data samples and limited adaptation steps. We formulate this framework as a bi-level optimization problem and provide an efficient solution with reduced storage complexity and few approximations. The proposed framework is general, allowing various learning algorithms to be integrated. To demonstrate this flexibility, we propose two specific learning algorithms that can be incorporated into our framework based on a neural state-space model and a deep Q-network, respectively. The primary distinction between these approaches is whether explicit system identification is required. Numerical simulations and hardware experiments demonstrate that the proposed methods enhance control performance and consistently outperform baseline approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于元学习（iMAML）的控制框架，通过离线从源系统学习共享动力学表征，再在线用少量目标系统数据微调，解决不确定非线性系统的参考跟踪问题。框架表述为双层优化，支持神经网络状态空间模型和深度Q网络两种算法，仿真与实验验证了优越性。
AI.motivation: 目标系统数据难以获取，传统控制方法需要大量数据或精确模型；利用源系统数据先验知识，以少量目标数据实现最优控制。
AI.method: 基于iMAML的元学习控制框架：离线元训练阶段从源系统数据学习共享动力学表征（双层优化）；在线元适应阶段用少量目标数据微调表征。支持两种算法：①神经状态空间模型（需系统辨识）；②深度Q网络（免系统辨识）。
AI.result: 数值仿真与硬件实验表明，所提方法在控制性能和样本效率上均持续优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 元学习可有效将源系统知识迁移到目标系统，显著降低目标系统数据需求，框架具有通用性和灵活性。
idea_en: A meta-learning control framework based on implicit model-agnostic meta-learning (iMAML) tailored for uncertain nonlinear systems, featuring a bi-level optimization for offline meta-training of shared dynamics representation from source systems and online meta-adaptation with few target system samples.
A neural state-space model integrated with the meta-learning framework for explicit system identification, enabling reference tracking with limited target data.
A deep Q-network integrated with the meta-learning framework for model-free control, eliminating the need for explicit system identification while leveraging source system knowledge.
A storage-efficient solution for the bi-level optimization in meta-learning control that reduces storage complexity and approximations compared to standard iMAML implementation.
idea_ch: 一种基于隐式模型无关元学习（iMAML）的非线性系统控制框架，通过双层优化结构实现：离线阶段从多个源系统学习共享动力学表征，在线阶段仅需少量目标系统样本即可快速适应，解决目标系统数据稀缺下的参考跟踪问题。
一种融合元学习的神经状态空间模型方法，在元训练阶段学习系统动力学先验，元适应阶段用极少目标数据完成系统辨识，实现数据高效的控制策略。
一种融合元学习的深度Q网络免模型控制方法，无需显式系统辨识，通过元学习将源系统策略知识迁移至目标系统，适应未知非线性动力学。
一种针对元学习控制框架的存储高效优化方法，通过改进iMAML的双层优化求解过程，降低存储复杂度和近似误差，提升计算效率。

title: A Subjective Logic-based method for runtime confidence updates in safety arguments
comment: Accepted for publication at the 41st ACM/SIGAPP Symposium on Applied Computing (SAC 2026)
summary: We present a method for dynamic quantitative assurance that enhances static safety cases with continuous, runtime-driven confidence updates. The method quantifies and propagates confidence across the development lifecycle by integrating design-time evidence and windowed runtime Safety Performance Indicators (SPIs) within a single Subjective Logic (SL)-based assurance case. At runtime, SPI evidence is continuously evaluated, and targeted claims are updated using a rule that increases confidence in the absence of violations and imposes prompt penalties when violations occur. This design prioritizes safety-relevant responsiveness over exact classical Bayesian posterior updates. We demonstrate the method using a simulation-based construction zone assist function, focusing on an ML-based construction cone detection component, and show how confidence evolves as SPI evidence is observed in operation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种动态量化保证方法，通过运行时持续更新的置信度来增强静态安全案例。该方法利用主观逻辑（SL）将设计时证据与运行时安全性能指标（SPI）整合，并对违规行为进行即时惩罚，在仿真建筑区辅助功能上进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 静态安全案例无法适应运行时环境变化，需要一种能动态反映系统运行状态、持续更新置信度的保证方法，以增强安全案例对实际运行环境的响应能力。
AI.method: 基于主观逻辑（SL）构建统一保证案例，融合设计时证据和窗口化运行时SPI。运行时持续评估SPI证据，采用特殊更新规则：无违规时提升置信度，出现违规时立即施加惩罚，优先保证安全相关响应速度而非精确贝叶斯后验更新。
AI.result: 在仿真建筑区辅助功能中，针对基于ML的施工锥检测组件进行了演示，展示了随运行时SPI证据观察置信度的演化过程。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过运行时动态置信度更新，有效弥合了静态安全设计与动态运行环境之间的鸿沟，为安全关键系统提供了更实时、更灵活的保证机制。
idea_en: Dynamic quantitative assurance method integrating static safety cases with runtime confidence updates using Subjective Logic.
Windowed Runtime Safety Performance Indicators (SPIs) evaluation mechanism for continuous confidence adjustment.
Violation-prioritized confidence update rule that increases confidence in normal operation and imposes prompt penalties on violations.
Subjective Logic-based unified assurance framework combining design-time and runtime evidence.
Safety-relevant responsiveness-optimized confidence update approach deviating from exact Bayesian posterior updates.
idea_ch: 基于主观逻辑的静态安全案例与运行时置信度动态更新融合方法
窗口化运行时安全性能指标（SPI）持续评估与置信度动态调整机制
违规优先的置信度更新规则：正常工作提升置信度、违规立即惩罚
融合设计时证据与运行时证据的主观逻辑统一保证框架
面向安全相关响应速度优化的置信度更新方法（偏离精确贝叶斯后验更新）

title: TerminalWorld: Benchmarking Agents on Real-World Terminal Tasks
summary: We introduce TerminalWorld, a scalable data engine that automatically reverse-engineers high-fidelity evaluation tasks from "in-the-wild" terminal recordings. Processing 80,870 terminal recordings, the engine yields a full benchmark of 1,530 validated tasks, spanning 18 real-world categories, ranging from short everyday operations to workflows exceeding 50 steps, and covering 1,280 unique commands. From these, we curate a Verified subset of 200 representative, manually reviewed tasks. Comprehensive benchmarking on TerminalWorld-Verified across eight frontier models and six agents reveals that current systems still struggle with authentic terminal workflows, achieving a maximum pass rate of only 62.5%. Moreover, TerminalWorld captures real-world terminal capabilities distinct from existing expert-curated benchmarks (e.g., Terminal-Bench), with only a weak correlation to their scores (Pearson r=0.20). The automated engine makes TerminalWorld authentic and scalable by construction, enabling it to evaluate agents in real-world terminal environments as developer practices evolve. Data and code are available at https://github.com/EuniAI/TerminalWorld.

AI.tldr: TerminalWorld是一个可扩展的数据引擎，能从真实终端录制中自动逆向工程出高质量评估任务，生成了涵盖1530个验证任务的基准测试，并揭示当前AI系统在真实终端工作流上表现有限（最高通过率仅62.5%）。
AI.motivation: 现有终端AI代理基准测试多为专家人工设计，缺乏对真实世界终端使用场景的覆盖和可扩展性，无法反映开发者实际工作中的复杂性和多样性。
AI.method: 从80870个终端录制中自动逆向工程评估任务，提取出1530个验证任务，涵盖18个真实类别、1280个独特命令，并从中精选200个经过人工审核的代表性任务作为Verified子集。
AI.result: 在TerminalWorld-Verified上测试8个前沿模型和6个代理系统，最高通过率仅62.5%；与现有专家基准（如Terminal-Bench）相关性弱（Pearson r=0.20），表明捕捉了不同的真实终端能力。
AI.conclusion: TerminalWorld通过自动化引擎实现了真实性和可扩展性，能够随着开发者实践演变持续评估终端代理，为终端AI评估提供了更真实的基准。
idea_en: Method for automatic reverse-engineering of evaluation tasks from terminal recordings, converting unstructured shell session logs into structured, validated benchmark tasks.
System for large-scale extraction of command workflows from 'in-the-wild' terminal recordings, including automated task validation and categorization across 18 real-world categories.
Technique for constructing a verified benchmark subset with manual review from automatically generated tasks, ensuring both scale and quality in terminal agent evaluation.
Method for evaluating AI agent performance on authentic terminal tasks derived from real developer recordings, distinct from synthetic or expert-curated benchmarks.
Scalable data pipeline architecture for continuously updating terminal agent benchmarks from streaming developer terminal recordings, enabling adaptive evaluation as practices evolve.
idea_ch: 从终端录制中自动逆向工程评估任务的方法：将非结构化的Shell会话日志转化为结构化、经过验证的基准测试任务
大规模从真实终端录制中提取命令工作流的系统：包括自动任务验证和18个真实世界类别的分类技术
从自动生成任务中构建经人工审核的验证基准子集的技术：兼顾终端代理评估的规模与质量
基于真实开发者终端录制的AI代理性能评估方法：区别于合成数据或专家策划的基准测试
可扩展数据流水线架构：从流式开发者终端录制中持续更新终端代理基准，支持随实践演变的自适应评估

title: Think Thrice Before You Speak: Dual knowledge-enhanced Theory-of-Mind Reasoning for Persuasive Agents
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures
summary: Persuasive dialogue requires reasoning about others' latent mental states, a capability known as Theory of Mind (ToM). However, due to reliance on simple prompting strategies and insufficient ToM knowledge, existing LLMs often fail to capture the intrinsic dependencies among mental states, leading to fragmented representations and unstable reasoning. To address these challenges, we introduce the ToM-based Persuasive Dialogue (ToM-PD) task, grounded in the Belief-Desire-Intention (BDI) framework, which explicitly models the sequential dependencies among mental states in multi-turn dialogues. To facilitate research on this task, we construct a large-scale annotated dataset, ToM-based Broad Persuasive Dialogues (ToM-BPD), capturing fine-grained mental states and corresponding persuasive strategies. We further propose Think Thrice Before You Speak (TTBYS), a knowledge-enhanced stepwise reasoning framework that leverages both explicit and implicit prior experiences to improve LLMs' inference of desires, beliefs, and persuasive strategies. Experimental results demonstrate that Qwen3-8B equipped with TTBYS outperforms GPT-5 by 1.20%, 22.80%, and 16.97% in predicting desires, beliefs, and persuasive strategies, respectively. Case studies further show that our approach enhances interpretability and consistency in reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于心理理论的说服对话任务（ToM-PD），构建了大规模标注数据集ToM-BPD，并设计了知识增强的分步推理框架TTBYS，在意图、信念和说服策略预测上超越GPT-5。

AI.conclusion: TTBYS框架能有效提升LLM在多轮说服对话中心理状态推理的准确性和可解释性。

title: Spreadsheet-RL: Advancing Large Language Model Agents on Realistic Spreadsheet Tasks via Reinforcement Learning
comment: Mingyuan served as the project lead. Banghao, Yining, and Mingyuan contributed equally to this work, with more junior authors listed before senior authors. All data and code releases are maintained by the corresponding authors at UIUC and are not affiliated with Meta
summary:
Spreadsheet systems (e.g., Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets) play a central role in modern data-centric workflows. As AI agents grow increasingly capable of automating complex tasks, such as controlling computers and generating presentations, building an AI-driven spreadsheet agent has emerged as a promising research direction. Most existing spreadsheet agents rely on specialized prompting over general-purpose LLMs; while this design has potentials on simple spreadsheet operations, it struggles to manage the complex, multi-step workflows typical of real-world applications.
  We introduce Spreadsheet-RL, a reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning framework designed to train specialized spreadsheet agents within a realistic Microsoft Excel environment. Spreadsheet-RL features an automated pipeline for scalable collection of paired start-goal spreadsheets from online forums, as well as domain-specific evaluation tasks in areas such as finance and supply chain management, which we compile into the new Domain-Spreadsheet benchmark dataset. It also includes a Spreadsheet Gym environment designed for multi-turn RL: Spreadsheet Gym exposes extensive Excel functionality through a Python sandbox, along with a refined harness that incorporates a comprehensive tool set and carefully designed tool-routing rules for spreadsheet tasks. Through comprehensive experiments, we show that Spreadsheet-RL substantially enhances AI agent's performance on both general and domain-specific spreadsheet tasks: it improves Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507's Pass@1 on SpreadsheetBench from 12.0% to 23.4%, and raises Pass@1 from 8.4% to 17.2% on our curated Domain-Spreadsheet dataset. These results highlight Spreadsheet-RL's strong potential for generalization and real-world adoption in spreadsheet automation, and broadly, its promise for advancing LLM-based interactions with data interfaces in everyday work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Spreadsheet-RL，一个基于强化学习微调的框架，用于在真实Microsoft Excel环境中训练专门的电子表格智能体。它包含自动化数据收集管道、领域专用基准数据集和Spreadsheet Gym多轮强化学习环境，实验表明该方法在通用和领域专用电子表格任务上均显著提升了AI智能体的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有电子表格智能体大多依赖通用大语言模型的专门提示设计，虽然能处理简单操作，但在实际应用中复杂的多步工作流中表现不佳，亟需一种专门针对电子表格任务进行训练的方法。
AI.method: 构建了自动化管道从在线论坛规模化收集配对的起始-目标电子表格数据；创建了金融、供应链管理等领域的Domain-Spreadsheet基准数据集；设计了Spreadsheet Gym环境，通过Python沙箱暴露Excel功能，并集成综合工具集和工具路由规则，支持多轮强化学习微调。
AI.result: Spreadsheet-RL在SpreadsheetBench上将Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507的Pass@1从12.0%提升至23.4%，在Domain-Spreadsheet数据集上将Pass@1从8.4%提升至17.2%。
AI.conclusion: Spreadsheet-RL在电子表格自动化方面展现出强大的泛化能力和实际应用潜力，为推进基于LLM的数据交互界面研究奠定了基础。
idea_en: A reinforcement learning fine-tuning framework specifically designed for training spreadsheet agents in a realistic Microsoft Excel environment, featuring an automated pipeline for scalable collection of paired start-goal spreadsheets from online forums.

title: AtelierEval: Agentic Evaluation of Humans & LLMs as Text-to-Image Prompters
comment: Accepted by ICML 2026
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) systems increasingly rely on upstream prompters, either humans or multimodal large language models (MLLMs), to translate user intent into detailed prompts. Yet current benchmarks fix the prompt and only evaluate T2I models, leaving the prompting proficiency of this upstream component entirely unmeasured. We introduce AtelierEval, the first unified benchmark that quantifies prompting proficiency across 360 expert-crafted tasks. Grounded in a cognitive view, it spans three task categories and instantiates tasks using a taxonomy of real-world challenges, with a dual interface for both humans and MLLMs. To enable scalable and reliable evaluation, we propose AtelierJudge, a skill-based, memory-augmented agentic evaluator. It produces subjective and objective scores for prompt-image pairs, achieving a Spearman correlation of 0.79 with human experts, approaching human performance. Extensive experiments benchmark 8 MLLMs against 48 human users across 4 T2I backends, validate AtelierEval as a robust diagnostic tool, and reveal the superiority of mimicry over planning, advocating for an image-augmented direction for future prompters. Our work is released to support future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AtelierEval，首个统一评估提示词撰写能力的基准，涵盖360个专家设计任务，支持人类和MLLM两种接口；同时提出AtelierJudge，基于技能和记忆的智能评估器，可为主观和客观维度评分，揭示模仿优于规划的趋势。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像系统依赖上游提示器（人类或MLLM）将用户意图转化为详细提示词，但现有基准仅评估T2I模型本身，忽略了提示器的提示撰写能力。
AI.method: 提出AtelierEval统一基准，基于认知视角分为三类任务，利用真实世界挑战分类法实例化任务，支持人类和MLLM双接口。提出AtelierJudge评估器，采用基于技能和记忆的智能代理，生成主观+客观评分。
AI.result: AtelierJudge与人类专家的Spearman相关系数达0.79，接近人类水平。在8个MLLM、48名人类用户和4个T2I后端上的实验验证了AtelierEval作为诊断工具的鲁棒性，并揭示模仿策略优于规划策略。
AI.conclusion: AtelierEval填补了提示词撰写能力评估的空白，是有效的诊断工具；未来提示器应向图像增强方向演进。
idea_en: A unified benchmark (AtelierEval) for quantifying prompting proficiency of both humans and MLLMs in text-to-image systems, using 360 expert-crafted tasks across three cognitive-based categories.
A skill-based, memory-augmented agentic evaluator (AtelierJudge) that generates subjective and objective scores for prompt-image pairs, achieving Spearman correlation of 0.79 with human experts.
A dual-interface evaluation framework supporting both human users and MLLMs with consistent task taxonomy, enabling direct comparison of prompting proficiency across different entities.
A cognitive task taxonomy for T2I prompting that categorizes real-world challenges into three distinct categories, providing structured diagnostic insights for prompt quality assessment.
idea_ch: 一种统一的提示词撰写能力评估基准（AtelierEval），基于360个专家设计任务和三类认知任务分类，可量化人类和MLLM在文本到图像系统中的提示词撰写能力。
一种基于技能和记忆增强的智能评估代理（AtelierJudge），可对提示词-图像对生成主观和客观评分，与人类专家的Spearman相关系数达0.79。
一种支持人类用户和MLLM的双接口评估框架，采用一致的任务分类体系，实现不同实体间提示词撰写能力的直接对比。
一种用于T2I提示词评估的认知任务分类法，将真实世界挑战分为三类结构化任务，为提示词质量评估提供层次化诊断洞察。

title: Claw AI Lab: An Autonomous Multi-Agent Research Team
comment: Project page and code are available at https://github.com/Claw-AI-Lab/Claw-AI-Lab
summary: We present Claw AI Lab, a lab-native autonomous research platform that advances automated research from a hidden prompt-to-paper pipeline into an interactive AI laboratory. Rather than centering the system around a single agent or a fixed serial workflow, we allow users to instantiate a full research team from one prompt, with customizable roles, collaborative workflows, real-time monitoring, artifact inspection, and rollback/resume control through a unified dashboard. The platform also supports distinct research modes for exploration, multi-agent discussion, and reproduction, making autonomous research substantially more steerable and laboratory-like in practice. A key practical contribution of Claw AI Lab lies in its Claw-Code Harness, which connects local codebases, datasets, and checkpoints to runnable experiments and feeds execution artifacts back into the research loop. As a result, the harness improves not only execution integration, but also experimental completion and result integrity: experiments are easier to inspect, iterate on, and faithfully transfer into final papers, reducing common failure modes such as partial runs and malformed result reporting. In our internal evaluation on five AI research case studies, using AutoResearchClaw as the baseline, Claw AI Lab is consistently preferred by AI expert judges on idea novelty, experiment completeness, and paper presentation quality. We view Claw AI Lab as an early step toward a new paradigm: autonomous research as usable, interactive, and reliability-aware scientific infrastructure.

AI.tldr: Claw AI Lab是一个实验室本地的自主研究平台，将自动化研究从隐藏的"提示词到论文"管道升级为交互式AI实验室。它允许用户通过一个提示词实例化完整研究团队，支持可定制角色、协作工作流、实时监控、制品检查和回滚/恢复控制。其核心Claw-Code Harness连接本地代码库、数据集和检查点，实现可运行实验并将执行制品反馈到研究循环中。在五项AI研究案例的内部评估中，Claw AI Lab在创意新颖性、实验完整性和论文呈现质量上 consistently 被AI专家评委偏好。

AI.method: 1) 多智能体团队实例化：从单一提示词生成完整研究团队，角色可定制。2) 统一仪表盘：实时监控、制品检查、回滚/恢复控制。3) 多种研究模式：探索模式、多智能体讨论模式、复现模式。4) Claw-Code Harness：连接本地代码库、数据集和检查点，执行实验并反馈制品。
AI.result: 在五项AI研究案例的内部评估中，以AutoResearchClaw为基线，Claw AI Lab在创意新颖性、实验完整性和论文呈现质量上 consistently 被AI专家评委偏好。
AI.conclusion: Claw AI Lab代表了自主研究向可用、交互式、可靠性感知的科学基础设施转变的早期步骤。

title: WorkstreamBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on End-to-End Spreadsheet Tasks in Finance
summary: LLM agents are increasingly expected to carry out end-to-end workflows, producing complete artifacts from high-level user instructions. To meet enterprise needs, frontier AI labs have developed agents that can construct entire spreadsheets from scratch. This is especially relevant in finance, where core workflows such as financial modeling, forecasting, and scenario analysis are commonly conducted through spreadsheets. Yet, existing spreadsheet benchmarks do not measure this advanced capability, focusing instead on question-answering or single-formula edits. To address this gap, we provide one of the first evaluations of agents on end-to-end spreadsheet tasks, focusing on economically critical financial workflows such as modeling and scenario analysis. Since deliverables therein are routinely reviewed and revised by multiple stakeholders, judging their quality necessarily involves high-level criteria such as readability or ease of modification. To reflect the multidimensional nature of solution quality, we develop an evaluation taxonomy comprising three dimensions: Accuracy, Formula, and Format, each comprising fine-grained criteria that reflect professional standards. The Claude family leads the benchmark and produces the most professional-looking outputs in our qualitative review, but even the strongest agents frequently fall short of professional finance standards and degrade sharply as the difficulty increases beyond a few chained calculations. This suggests that current agents are not yet able to reliably produce professional-quality spreadsheets at the level of complexity real-world workflows demand.

AI.tldr: 本文首次评估了LLM代理在端到端电子表格任务（尤其是金融建模与场景分析）上的能力，提出了包含准确性、公式和格式三个维度的评估标准，发现即使是Claude系列等最强模型也难以达到专业金融标准。
AI.motivation: 现有电子表格基准仅关注问答或单公式编辑，缺乏对端到端工作流能力的评估，而金融领域要求代理能从头构建完整电子表格并满足专业质量标准。
AI.method: 构建了一个多维评估框架，包含Accuracy（准确性）、Formula（公式质量）、Format（格式规范性）三个维度的细粒度评价标准。
AI.result: Claude系列在该基准上表现最佳且输出最专业，但即使最强代理在难度增加时也急剧退化，无法可靠生成复杂程度达到实际工作流要求的专业电子表格。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM代理尚无法可靠生成符合专业金融标准的复杂电子表格，距离实际企业级工作流需求仍有较大差距。
idea_en: Multi-dimensional evaluation taxonomy for end-to-end spreadsheet agent outputs comprising Accuracy, Formula, and Format dimensions with fine-grained professional criteria.
An automated pipeline for generating financial modeling benchmarks from scratch that requires agents to produce complete spreadsheet artifacts from high-level instructions.
A structured readability and ease-of-modification scoring system for evaluating spreadsheet maintainability by multiple stakeholders.
idea_ch: 提出了一种多维评估体系，从准确性、公式质量和格式规范性三个维度对LLM代理生成的完整电子表格进行专业级评分。

开发了一套可维护性评分机制，用于评估代理生成的电子表格在多利益相关方审阅和修订场景下的可读性与易修改性。

title: Is Capability a Liability? More Capable Language Models Make Worse Forecasts When It Matters Most
summary: We document inverse scaling in LLMs on forecasting problems whose underlying time series exhibit superlinear growth and tail risk of regime change, a structure common in finance and epidemiology. On these tasks, more capable models produce worse distributional forecasts. The pattern appears on ForecastBench-Sim (FBSim), a contamination-free, simulated-world benchmark we release, in forecasting synthetic SIR epidemics with a matched linear control, and replicates in real-world datasets on COVID-19, measles, housing markets, and hyperinflation. A per-quantile decomposition shows the failure concentrates at the upper tail, which more capable models shift upward to track aggressive extrapolations of growth, while the lower tail stays put. A within-family study of Llama-3.1 shows that both model scale and post-training independently contribute to this effect. Domain knowledge does not reliably rescue calibration. This inverse scaling does not appear on single-threshold metrics common in LLM forecasting benchmarks, reversing the sign of the capability--accuracy relationship on identical outputs. Single-threshold scoring at conventional cutoffs misses the upper-tail cost; tail-inclusive scoring reverses the sign of the capability--accuracy relationship on the same outputs. We recommend that LLM forecasting evaluations use continuous (and unbounded) measures of accuracy alongside bounded binary threshold metrics.

AI.tldr: 论文发现LLM在预测具有超线性增长和尾部风险的时间序列时存在逆缩放现象——能力更强的模型反而产生更差的分布预测，该现象在金融和流行病学常见，且单阈值评估指标会掩盖这一问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM预测评估主要依赖单阈值指标（如分类准确率），忽略了分布预测中尾部风险的评估。论文旨在揭示LLM在超线性增长和尾部风险场景下的逆缩放问题，并指出当前评估指标的不足。
AI.method: 构建无污染模拟基准FBSim，包含合成SIR流行病预测任务及匹配的线性控制任务；在真实数据集（COVID-19、麻疹、房价、恶性通胀）上验证；采用分位数分解分析尾部失败；在Llama-3.1家族内研究模型规模和后训练的影响。
AI.result: 能力更强的模型在超线性增长时间序列的分布预测中表现更差，失败集中在分布的上尾；模型规模和后训练独立贡献该效应；领域知识不能可靠地校准预测；单阈值指标完全掩盖了逆缩放现象，而尾部包含的连续指标能逆转能力-准确度关系的符号。
AI.conclusion: LLM预测评估应使用连续（无界）的准确度指标，同时结合有界二元阈值指标，以全面评估模型在尾部风险场景下的表现。
idea_en: A forecasting benchmark system (FBSim) that generates contamination-free simulated time series data with controlled superlinear growth and regime change properties for evaluating LLM distributional forecasting capabilities.
A per-quantile decomposition method for diagnosing LLM forecasting failures that isolates upper-tail versus lower-tail prediction errors in distributional forecasts.

A tail-inclusive continuous scoring metric for LLM forecasting evaluation that reverses the capability-accuracy relationship sign compared to single-threshold metrics, enabling detection of inverse scaling phenomena.
A dual-metric evaluation framework combining continuous unbounded accuracy measures with bounded binary threshold metrics for comprehensive LLM forecasting assessment.
idea_ch: 一种无污染的模拟时间序列基准生成系统（FBSim），可生成具有可控超线性增长和制度变化特性的模拟数据，用于评估LLM的分布预测能力
一种逐分位数分解诊断方法，能够隔离分布预测中上尾与下尾的预测误差，精确定位LLM预测失败的具体分位区域
一种包含尾部的连续评分指标，相比单阈值指标能逆转能力-准确度关系的符号，用于检测LLM预测中的逆缩放现象
一种结合连续无界准确度度量与有界二元阈值指标的双指标评估框架，用于全面评估LLM在尾部风险场景下的预测性能

title: Forecasting Scientific Progress with Artificial Intelligence
comment: 73 pages, 13 figures, 29 tables
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in scientific discovery, yet whether it can anticipate scientific progress remains unclear. To study this question, we introduce a temporally grounded evaluation framework for forecasting scientific progress under controlled knowledge constraints. We present CUSP (Cutoff-conditioned Unseen Scientific Progress), a multi-disciplinary and event-level benchmark that evaluates scientific forecasting in AI systems through feasibility assessment, mechanistic reasoning, generative solution design, and temporal prediction. Across 4,760 scientific events, we observe systematic and domain-dependent limitations in current frontier models. While models can identify plausible research directions from competing candidates, they fail to reliably predict whether scientific advances will be realized and systematically misestimate when they will occur. Performance is highly heterogeneous across domains, with the timing of AI progress more predictable than advances in biology, chemistry, and physics. Performance is largely insensitive to whether events occur before or after the training cutoff, suggesting these limitations cannot be explained solely by knowledge exposure in training data. Under controlled information access, additional pre-cutoff knowledge improves performance but does not close the gap to full-information settings, which becomes more pronounced for high-citation advances. Models also exhibit systematic overconfidence and strong response biases, indicating unreliable uncertainty estimation. Taken together, current AI systems fall short as predictive tools for scientific progress. Access to prior knowledge does not translate into reliable forecasting, and performance benefits more from post-event information than from forward-looking prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CUSP基准框架，系统评估AI预测科学进展的能力。研究发现当前AI模型在科学预测方面存在系统性局限：无法可靠预测科学突破是否实现、何时发生，且在不同领域表现差异显著。模型存在过度自信和响应偏差，预测能力不随训练数据增加而显著提升。
AI.motivation: 探究AI是否能够预测科学进步，特别是在受控知识约束条件下评估其前瞻性预测能力。
AI.method: 构建CUSP（Cutoff-conditioned Unseen Scientific Progress）基准，这是一个多学科、事件级别的评估框架，通过可行性评估、机制推理、生成式解决方案设计和时间预测四个维度，对4,760个科学事件进行系统评估。
AI.result: 当前AI模型在科学预测中存在系统性局限：无法可靠预测科学突破是否实现及何时发生；不同领域表现差异大（AI进展时间预测优于生物/化学/物理）；训练数据截止前后性能无显著差异；额外知识可提升性能但无法接近全信息设置；模型存在过度自信和响应偏差。
AI.conclusion: 当前AI系统尚不能作为科学进展的可靠预测工具。先验知识无法转化为可靠预测能力，模型从事后信息中获益多于前瞻性预测。
idea_en: A temporally grounded evaluation framework (CUSP) for forecasting scientific progress under controlled knowledge constraints that systematically assesses AI systems through feasibility assessment, mechanistic reasoning, generative solution design, and temporal prediction across multi-disciplinary scientific events.

A cutoff-conditioned benchmark design that isolates the effect of training data exposure by comparing model performance on scientific events occurring before vs. after the training cutoff, enabling controlled study of whether knowledge exposure drives predictive capability.

A systematic methodology for measuring and calibrating overconfidence and response bias in AI systems when tasked with scientific forecasting, providing quantitative metrics for uncertainty estimation reliability.

A domain-heterogeneity analysis framework that quantifies differential predictability across scientific disciplines (AI progress, biology, chemistry, physics) and identifies which domains are more amenable to AI-based forecasting.
A controlled information access experimental paradigm that measures the marginal benefit of pre-cutoff knowledge vs. post-event information in improving scientific prediction accuracy.
idea_ch: 一种受控知识约束下科学进展预测的时间锚定评估框架（CUSP），通过可行性评估、机制推理、生成式解决方案设计和时间预测四个维度，系统评估AI系统在多学科科学事件上的预测能力。
一种基于训练数据截止日期的基准设计方法，通过比较模型在训练数据截止前后发生的科学事件上的表现差异，隔离训练数据暴露对预测能力的影响。
一种系统性测量和校准AI系统在科学预测任务中过度自信和响应偏差的方法，提供不确定性估计可靠性的量化指标。
一种领域异质性分析框架，量化不同科学学科（AI进展、生物学、化学、物理学）的可预测性差异，识别更适合AI预测的领域。
一种受控信息访问实验范式，测量预截止知识 vs. 事后信息对提高科学预测准确性的边际收益差异。

title: Beyond the Org Chart: AI and the Transformation of Invisible Work
comment: 10 pages
summary: An increasing number of news and research articles report that AI adoption is allowing professionals to blur and extend the boundaries of their corporate roles. With the goal of understanding how work processes might be changing in an AI-forward company, we interviewed 24 product-focused individuals at a large technology firm about how AI has impacted their own work, their work within their product team, and their professional interactions. Our conversations suggest that AI is not only changing formal role responsibilities and collaborations between those roles, but also changing informal cultural practices like professional mentoring that are key to helping professionals settle in their positions, stay engaged with their work, and grow their careers. Some of these changes are positive, such as smoother collaboration between peers, but other changes are more nuanced and put the typical career growth opportunities, like receiving feedback from professional networks and promoting leadership and mentorship, at risk. We propose steps that AI companies can take to make the invisible work more visible. Additionally, we propose efforts that individuals and leaders can take to support their colleagues through AI transformation while preserving healthy company cultures that support diverse thinking, collaboration, and informal interactions.

AI.tldr: 通过对一家大型科技公司24名产品人员的访谈，研究了AI如何改变正式角色职责、协作关系以及非正式文化实践（如职业指导），发现AI既带来积极变化（如更顺畅的协作），也带来隐性风险（如职业成长机会减少），并提出了使隐性工作显性化的建议。
AI.motivation: 了解在AI驱动型企业中，AI如何改变员工的工作流程、角色边界、团队协作以及非正式文化实践（如职业指导），以识别AI对职业发展和公司文化的潜在影响。
AI.method: 对一家大型科技公司24名产品相关人员进行半结构化访谈，分析AI对自身工作、团队协作和专业互动的影响。
AI.result: AI不仅改变了正式角色职责和协作关系，还改变了非正式文化实践（如职业指导）。积极变化包括同行协作更顺畅；消极变化包括职业成长机会（如从专业网络获得反馈、领导力和指导机会）面临风险。
AI.conclusion: 提出了AI公司使隐性工作显性化的步骤，以及个人和领导者如何在AI转型中支持同事、保持健康公司文化的建议。
idea_en: A system for making invisible AI-mediated work visible through automated tracking and visualization of informal mentorship interactions, feedback exchanges, and cross-role collaborations that are disrupted by AI tools

A method for preserving professional development pathways in AI-forward organizations by dynamically detecting and compensating for reduced mentorship and feedback opportunities caused by AI automation
An AI-aware role boundary management system that monitors and alerts when AI tools cause role creep or informal responsibility shifts beyond intended job scopes
idea_ch: 一种通过自动追踪和可视化AI中介的非正式指导互动、反馈交流和跨角色协作，使隐性工作显性化的系统
一种在AI驱动型组织中保留职业发展路径的方法，通过动态检测并补偿因AI自动化导致的指导和反馈机会减少
一种AI感知的角色边界管理系统，监控并在AI工具导致角色蔓延或非正式责任超出预期工作范围时发出警报

title: AMEL: Accumulated Message Effects on LLM Judgments
comment: 19 pages, 14 figures, 6 tables. Single author. Code, data (75,898 deduplicated API responses), and analysis pipeline at https://github.com/chutapp/amel
summary:
Large language models are routinely used as automated evaluators: to review code, moderate content, or score outputs, often with many items passing through one conversation. We ask whether the polarity of prior conversation history biases subsequent judgments, an effect we call the accumulated message effect on LLM judgments (AMEL). Across 75,898 API calls to 11 models from 4 providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and four open-source models), we present identical test items in isolation or following histories saturated with predominantly positive or negative evaluations.
  Models shift toward the conversation's prevailing polarity (d = -0.17, p < 10^-46). The effect concentrates on items where the model is genuinely uncertain at baseline (d = -0.34 for high-entropy items, vs d = -0.15 when the baseline is deterministic). Bias does not grow with context length: 5 prior turns and 50 produce the same shift (Spearman |r| < 0.01; OLS slope p = 0.80). And there is a negativity asymmetry: paired per item, negative histories induce 1.62x more bias than positive (t = 13.46, p < 10^-39, n = 2,481). Scaling helps but does not solve it (Anthropic: Haiku -0.22 to Opus -0.17; OpenAI: Nano -0.34 to GPT-5.2 -0.17).
  Three follow-ups narrow the mechanism. The token probability distribution shifts continuously, not at a threshold. The negativity asymmetry has both token-level and semantic components, though attributing the balance is exploratory at our sample sizes. Position does not matter: five biased turns anywhere in a 50-turn history produce the same shift. The simplest fix for evaluation pipelines is a fresh context per item; when batching is unavoidable, balancing the history helps.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型作为自动化评估者时，对话历史中先前的正面或负面评价会系统性影响后续判断，产生"累积信息效应"（AMEL），表现为判断偏向对话的主流极性，且负向偏差比正向更强（1.62倍）。简单解决方案：每项评估使用新上下文，或平衡历史极性。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM在连续对话中作为评估者时，先前的评价历史是否会系统性偏向后来的判断，即是否存在上下文偏差效应。
AI.method: 在75,898次API调用中，对11个模型（来自OpenAI、Anthropic、Google及开源）分别呈现相同测试项，比较其在隔离状态与充满正面/负面评价的历史后的判断差异。
AI.result: 模型判断向对话主流极性偏移（d=-0.17, p<10^-46）；偏差在模型基线不确定时更强（高熵项d=-0.34 vs 确定性项d=-0.15）；偏差不随上下文长度增长；负向偏差是正向的1.62倍；规模扩展可缓解但无法解决。
AI.conclusion: 评估流程的最佳实践是每项使用新上下文；必要批处理时平衡历史极性可减轻偏差。
idea_en: A method for debiasing LLM-based automated evaluations by resetting conversation context per evaluation item to eliminate accumulated message effect.
A system for balancing the polarity of evaluation history in batch LLM evaluations to mitigate judgment bias.
A mechanism for detecting baseline uncertainty of LLM on evaluation items using token entropy, and flagging items where bias susceptibility is highest.
A negativity-aware evaluation pipeline that compensates for the 1.62x stronger negative bias effect by asymmetrically weighting positive/negative history.
A method for continuously monitoring token probability distribution shifts across conversation turns as an early indicator of judgment bias onset.
idea_ch: 一种通过为每个评估项重置对话上下文来消除LLM自动化评估中累积信息效应的去偏方法
一种在批量LLM评估中平衡评估历史极性以减轻判断偏差的系统
一种利用令牌熵检测LLM在评估项上的基线不确定性、标记高偏差易感项的机制
一种负向感知评估流水线，通过不对称加权正/负历史来补偿1.62倍更强的负向偏差效应
一种跨对话轮次持续监控令牌概率分布偏移的方法，作为判断偏差起始的早期指标

title: Parametric Modular Answer Set Programs Made Declarative
comment: To appear in Theory and Practice of Logic Programming
summary: In this paper, we explore the concept of modularity in first-order answer set programming (ASP). We introduce a new formalism called parametric modular logic programs, which allows defining subprograms with parameters and intensionality statements. We demonstrate how this formalism can capture the semantics of clingo-programs with collective control, a feature that enables structuring and instantiating subprograms. We provide theoretical foundations for modular ASP, illustrate its usefulness, and connect to traditional non-modular ASP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的参数化模块逻辑程序形式化方法，用于一阶回答集编程中的模块化，能够捕捉带有集体控制的clingo程序的语义，并提供了理论基础。
AI.motivation: 回答集编程(ASP)中缺乏模块化支持，使得大型程序难以构建和维护，需要一种形式化的模块化框架来支持参数化子程序的定义和复用。
AI.method: 提出了参数化模块逻辑程序(Parametric Modular Logic Programs)形式化方法，支持子程序定义中的参数和内涵性声明，并通过集体控制机制实现子程序的实例化。
AI.result: 证明了该形式化方法能够捕捉clingo-programs中集体控制的语义，连接了模块化ASP与传统非模块化ASP，建立了理论基础。
AI.conclusion: 参数化模块逻辑程序是一种有效的ASP模块化形式化方法，为大型ASP程序的构建和推理提供了理论基础，并展示了与传统ASP的兼容性。
idea_en: A parametric modular logic programming system with intensionality declarations that allows subprograms to declare which predicates are intensional (defined within the module) vs extensional (provided externally), enabling clean separation of concerns and module reuse.
A collective control mechanism for modular logic programs that enables structured instantiation of parameterized subprograms with controlled grounding, reducing computational complexity.
A formal semantics framework for modular answer set programming that bridges the gap between traditional non-modular ASP and modular programming paradigms through parameterized module composition.
idea_ch: 一种带有内涵性声明的参数化模块逻辑编程系统，允许子程序声明哪些谓词是内涵性的（在模块内定义）哪些是外延性的（由外部提供），实现关注点分离和模块复用。
一种用于模块逻辑程序的集体控制机制，能够对参数化子程序进行结构化实例化并控制其实例化范围，降低计算复杂度。
一种连接传统非模块化ASP与模块化编程范式的形式语义框架，通过参数化模块组合实现模块化回答集编程的语义理论基础。

title: Can AI Make Conflicts Worse? An Alignment Failure in LLM Deployment Across Conflict Contexts
comment: Preprint. 8 pages, 2 figures. Code and evaluation framework: https://github.com/akryshtal/conflict-sensitivity-eval-bloom
summary: AI models are already deployed in societies affected by armed conflict, and journalists, humanitarian workers, governments and ordinary citizens rely on them for information or for their work processes. No established practice exists for checking whether their outputs can make those conflicts worse. We tested nine model configurations from four providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, xAI) on 90 multi-turn scenarios designed to surface misaligned behaviour in conflict contexts: false equivalence between documented atrocities, denial of genocide, and failure to recognise ethnic slurs, among others. When such outputs feed into journalism, humanitarian reporting, or public debate, they can deepen divisions in fragile societies. Failure rates span 6\% to 47\% between the best and worst performing models, which makes model choice a safety question in its own right and when users pushed for ``balance'' in cases where international courts have already assigned responsibility, five of nine configurations failed 80 to 100 percent of the time. We release the first evaluation framework for this domain and propose adding it to alignment evaluation portfolios.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估了9种AI模型在冲突场景中的对齐失败率（6%-47%），发现当用户要求"平衡"叙述时，5种模型在80%-100%的情况下会错误地将已定性的战争罪行与虚假信息对等，发布了首个冲突场景AI对齐评估框架。
AI.motivation: AI模型已在武装冲突地区被部署，被记者、人道主义工作者、政府和公民用于信息获取和工作流程，但缺乏评估其输出是否会加剧冲突的既定实践。
AI.method: 测试了来自OpenAI、Anthropic、DeepSeek、xAI四家提供商的9种模型配置，设计了90个多轮对话场景，用于检测在冲突情境中的失调行为，包括对已记录暴行的虚假对等、否认种族灭绝、未能识别种族歧视性言论等。
AI.result: 最佳与最差模型之间的失败率从6%到47%不等；当用户推动"平衡"叙述时，9种配置中有5种在80%-100%的情况下失败；发布了首个该领域的评估框架。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择本身成为一个安全问题，提议将冲突场景评估纳入对齐评估组合中。
idea_en: A multi-turn scenario-based evaluation framework specifically designed to detect misaligned AI behaviors in armed conflict contexts, including false equivalence, genocide denial, and ethnic slur recognition failures.

A stress-testing methodology that assesses AI model safety by measuring failure rates when users intentionally push for 'balance' in cases where international courts have already assigned responsibility for war crimes.
An alignment evaluation portfolio expansion that incorporates conflict-sensitivity testing as a standard component for AI models deployed in volatile regions.

A systematic approach to classify and measure model failure types in conflict-related outputs, distinguishing between false equivalence, denial of established atrocities, and failure to recognize hate speech.
idea_ch: 一种多轮场景驱动的AI对齐评估框架，专门检测模型在武装冲突情境中的失调行为，包括虚假对等、种族灭绝否认和仇恨言论识别失败等场景
一种压力测试方法，通过评估模型在用户刻意推动'平衡'叙述时（针对国际法庭已定性的战争罪行）的失败率，量化AI模型的安全性
一种扩展的对齐评估组合方案，将冲突敏感性测试作为部署于动荡地区的AI模型的标准评估组件
一种系统性的模型输出失败类型分类与度量方法，区分冲突相关输出中的虚假对等、否认已记录暴行和无法识别仇恨言论等不同失败模式

title: Beyond Acoustic Emotion Recognition: Multimodal Pathos Analysis in Political Speech Using LLM-Based and Acoustic Emotion Models
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure
summary: We investigate whether acoustic emotion recognition models can serve as proxies for the Pathos dimension in political speech analysis, as operationalised by the TRUST multi-agent large language model (LLM) pipeline. Using a Bundestag plenary speech by Felix Banaszak (51 segments, 245 s) as a case study, we compare three analysis modalities: (1) emotion2vec_plus_large, an acoustic speech emotion recognition (SER) model whose continuous Arousal and Valence values are derived via post-hoc Russell Circumplex projection; (2) Gemini 2.5 Flash, an LLM analysing the full speech audio together with its transcript in an open-ended, context-aware fashion; and (3) TRUST-Pathos scores from a three-advocate LLM supervisor ensemble. Spearman rank correlations reveal that Gemini Valence correlates strongly with TRUST-Pathos (rho = +0.664, p < 0.001), whereas emotion2vec Valence does not (rho = +0.097, p = 0.499). We further demonstrate, via a systematic quality evaluation of the Berlin Database of Emotional Speech (EMO-DB) using Gemini in an open-ended annotation paradigm, that standard SER benchmark corpora suffer from acted speech, cultural bias, and category incompatibility. Our results suggest that LLM-based multimodal analysis captures semantically defined political emotion substantially better than acoustic models alone, while acoustic features remain informative for low-level Arousal estimation. Future work will extend this approach to video-based analysis incorporating facial expression and gaze.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了声学情感识别模型能否作为政治演讲分析中Pathos维度的代理，通过比较三种分析模态：声学语音情感识别模型emotion2vec、多模态LLM Gemini 2.5 Flash、以及TRUST多智能体LLM管线的Pathos评分。结果表明，LLM-based多模态分析在捕捉语义定义的政治情感方面显著优于纯声学模型，而声学特征仍对低层次唤醒度估计有效。
AI.motivation: 探索声学情感识别模型能否作为政治演讲中Pathos（情感诉求）维度的有效代理，以及比较不同分析模态（纯声学模型 vs. 多模态LLM vs. 多智能体LLM管线）在政治情感分析中的表现。
AI.method: 以德国联邦议院Felix Banaszak的演讲（51个片段，245秒）为案例，比较三种分析模态：(1) emotion2vec_plus_large声学SER模型，通过Russel Circumplex投影得到连续Arousal和Valence值；(2) Gemini 2.5 Flash多模态LLM分析完整音频和文本；(3) TRUST-Pathos评分由三智能体LLM监督集成产生。使用Spearman秩相关分析，并在EMO-DB情感语音数据库上进行系统性质量评估。
AI.result: Gemini Valence与TRUST-Pathos强相关（rho=+0.664, p<0.001），而emotion2vec Valence不相关（rho=+0.097, p=0.499）。标准SER基准语料库（EMO-DB）存在表演性语音、文化偏倚和类别不兼容性问题。
AI.conclusion: LLM-based多模态分析在捕捉语义定义的政治情感方面显著优于纯声学模型，声学特征对低层次唤醒度估计仍有价值。未来工作将扩展到基于视频的面部表情和注视分析。
idea_en: A multi-agent LLM supervisor ensemble pipeline (TRUST) for computing Pathos dimension scores in political speech analysis, using three advocate LLMs to generate consensus-based emotion ratings.

A method for deriving continuous Arousal and Valence values from acoustic SER models via post-hoc Russell Circumplex projection, enabling dimensional emotion representation from categorical acoustic features.

A multimodal political speech analysis framework combining acoustic emotion recognition (emotion2vec) with LLM-based semantic analysis (Gemini 2.5 Flash) for complementary Arousal and Valence estimation.

An open-ended annotation paradigm using LLMs (Gemini) for systematic quality evaluation of emotional speech databases, capable of detecting acted speech, cultural bias, and category incompatibility issues.
idea_ch: 一种用于政治演讲分析中Pathos维度计算的多智能体LLM监督集成管线（TRUST），通过三个立场不同的LLM生成共识性情感评分。
一种通过事后Russell Circumplex投影从声学SER模型中推导连续Arousal和Valence值的方法，实现了从分类声学特征到维度情感表示的转换。
一种结合声学情感识别模型（emotion2vec）与基于LLM的语义分析（Gemini 2.5 Flash）的多模态政治演讲分析框架，实现互补的Arousal和Valence估计。
一种利用LLM（Gemini）进行开放端标注范式的语音情感数据库系统性质量评估方法，能够检测表演性语音、文化偏倚和类别不兼容性等问题。

title: HarnessAPI: A Skill-First Framework for Unified Streaming APIs and MCP Tools
summary: Every Python function deployed as an LLM tool must today exist in two forms: an HTTP endpoint for human-facing clients and CI pipelines, and an MCP tool registration for agent runtimes such as Claude and Cursor. These representations share business logic yet diverge in all the surrounding machinery (routing, validation, serialisation, streaming, and schema maintenance), and they drift apart as the underlying code evolves. We present HarnessAPI, a Python framework that eliminates this duplication by treating a typed skill folder as the single source of truth. From one handler.py plus Pydantic schemas, the framework automatically derives a streaming HTTP endpoint with Server-Sent Events, an interactive OpenAPI/Swagger UI, and a zero-configuration MCP tool, all served from a single process. Dual-mode content negotiation lets the same handler serve SSE-streaming and JSON-returning clients with no handler changes. A dynamic code-generation mechanism ensures Pydantic type annotations propagate correctly to FastMCP's inspection layer, resolving a technical limitation that prevents naive closure-based registration. Measured across six representative skills using cloc, HarnessAPI reduces framework-facing boilerplate by 74% compared with a manually maintained dual-stack implementation (FastAPI server + FastMCP server). HarnessAPI subclasses FastAPI, inheriting its full middleware, dependency-injection, and deployment ecosystem. It is available at https://github.com/edwinjosechittilappilly/harnessapi and on PyPI (pip install harnessapi)

AI.tldr: HarnessAPI是一个Python框架，通过将类型化的技能文件夹作为单一事实来源，自动为LLM工具生成HTTP端点（FastAPI）和MCP工具注册，消除了双栈维护的重复工作，减少74%的框架样板代码。
AI.motivation: 当前每个作为LLM工具的Python函数需要同时维护两种形式：面向人类客户端和CI管道的HTTP端点，以及面向Agent运行时的MCP工具注册。两者共享业务逻辑但在路由、验证、序列化、流式和Schema维护等周边机制上完全不同，且随代码演进容易产生漂移。
AI.method: 1) 将类型化的技能文件夹作为单一事实来源，从handler.py和Pydantic schema自动派生流式HTTP端点(SSE)、交互式OpenAPI/Swagger UI和零配置MCP工具；2) 双模内容协商使同一handler无需修改即可同时服务SSE流式客户端和JSON返回客户端；3) 动态代码生成机制确保Pydantic类型注解正确传播到FastMCP的检查层，解决闭包注册的技术限制。
AI.result: 在六个代表性技能上测试，与手动维护的双栈实现（FastAPI服务器+FastMCP服务器）相比，HarnessAPI减少了74%的框架层面样板代码。该框架继承FastAPI，拥有完整的中间件、依赖注入和部署生态系统。
AI.conclusion: HarnessAPI通过单一事实来源和自动化代码生成，有效解决了Python函数作为LLM工具时HTTP端点和MCP注册的双重维护问题，显著减少样板代码量，并保证了两种表示的同步一致性。
idea_en: A method for automatically generating dual-mode (SSE streaming and JSON-returning) HTTP endpoints and MCP tool registrations from a single typed skill folder, using Pydantic schemas as the single source of truth.

A dynamic code-generation mechanism that propagates Pydantic type annotations to FastMCP's inspection layer, solving the technical limitation of naive closure-based registration in MCP tool generation.
Dual-mode content negotiation system that allows the same handler function to serve both SSE-streaming clients and traditional JSON-returning clients without any handler modifications.

A unified Python framework that subclasses FastAPI to inherit its full middleware, dependency injection, and deployment ecosystem while automatically deriving MCP tool registrations, eliminating the need for separate dual-stack maintenance.
Zero-configuration MCP tool derivation system that extracts tool definitions directly from Python function signatures and Pydantic schema annotations without requiring separate configuration files.

动态代码生成机制，将Pydantic类型注解正确传播到FastMCP的检查层，解决了基于闭包的朴素注册方法在MCP工具生成中的技术限制

title: Towards a General Intelligence and Interface for Wearable Health Data
summary: While ubiquitous wearable sensors capture a wealth of behavioral and physiological information, effectively transforming these signals into personalized health insights is challenging. Specifically, converting low-level sensor data into representations capable of characterizing higher-level states is difficult due to high phenotypic diversity and variation in individual baseline health, physiology, and lifestyle factors. Moreover, collecting wearable data paired with health outcome annotations is laborious and expensive, and retrospective annotation remains practically unfeasible, contributing to a scarcity of data with high-quality labels. To overcome these limitations, we propose a foundation model for wearable health that is pretrained on more than one trillion minutes of unlabeled sensor signals drawn from a large cohort of five million participants. We demonstrate that the joint scaling of model capacity and pretraining data volume leads to systematic improvements in performance, as evaluated on a diverse set of 35 health prediction tasks, spanning cardiovascular, metabolic, sleep, and mental health, as well as lifestyle choices and demographic factors. We find that this population scale representation unlocks label-efficient few-shot learning and generative capabilities for robust daily metric estimation. To further leverage this learned representation, we deploy a classroom of LLM agents to autonomously search the space of downstream predictive heads built on the model embeddings, showing broad performance improvements that increase with LLM model capacity. Finally, we show how integrating these downstream predictors into a Personal Health Agent can support model responses that are more relevant, contextually aware, and safe, and we validate this via 1,860 ratings from a cohort of clinicians.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于超过1万亿分钟、500万参与者可穿戴传感器信号的医疗健康基础模型，通过联合扩展模型容量与预训练数据量，在35项健康预测任务上取得系统性性能提升，并利用LLM智能体自动搜索下游预测头架构，最终集成到个人健康智能体中，经1860项临床评分验证其相关性、上下文感知能力与安全性。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴传感器数据转化为个性化健康洞察面临两大挑战：一是高表型多样性与个体基线差异导致低层传感器信号难以表征高层健康状态；二是带有健康结局标注的数据采集成本高、回顾性标注不可行，导致高质量标签数据稀缺。
AI.method: 1）在超过1万亿分钟、500万参与者的无标签可穿戴传感器信号上预训练基础模型；2）联合扩展模型容量与预训练数据量，提升35项健康预测任务性能；3）部署LLM智能体集群自动搜索下游预测头架构；4）将下游预测器集成到个人健康智能体中。
AI.result: 在心血管、代谢、睡眠、心理健康、生活方式及人口统计因素等35项健康预测任务上取得系统性性能提升；实现标签高效的少样本学习与鲁棒的日常指标估计生成能力；LLM智能体搜索方法随模型容量增加持续提升性能；集成后的个人健康智能体经1860项临床评分验证更相关、上下文感知且安全。
AI.conclusion: 大规模无标签可穿戴传感器数据的预训练结合模型与数据联合扩展，可有效解决标签数据稀缺问题，生成的表示能支持多种下游健康预测任务，而LLM智能体搜索与个人健康智能体架构进一步提升了实用性与安全性。
idea_en: A foundation model training method for wearable health data pretrained on over one trillion minutes of unlabeled sensor signals from five million participants, enabling systematic performance improvement across diverse health prediction tasks through joint scaling of model capacity and pretraining data volume.

A label-efficient few-shot learning system for wearable health analytics that leverages population-scale pretrained representations to generate robust daily health metric estimations with minimal labeled data.

A multi-LLM-agent classroom architecture that autonomously searches the space of downstream predictive heads built on foundation model embeddings, where the search performance improves with increasing LLM model capacity.

A Personal Health Agent framework that integrates downstream predictors with LLM-based processing to deliver health-related responses with enhanced relevance, contextual awareness, and safety, validated by clinician ratings.

A method for retrospective annotation-free health outcome prediction using self-supervised pretraining on massive unlabeled wearable sensor data, overcoming the scarcity of high-quality labeled health datasets.
idea_ch: 一种基于超过1万亿分钟、500万参与者无标签可穿戴传感器信号预训练的基础模型训练方法，通过联合扩展模型容量与预训练数据量，在多样化健康预测任务中实现系统性性能提升。
一种用于可穿戴健康分析的标签高效少样本学习系统，利用群体规模预训练表示以最少标签数据生成鲁棒的日常健康指标估计。
一种多LLM智能体集群架构，可自主搜索基于基础模型嵌入构建的下游预测头空间，搜索性能随LLM模型容量增加而提升。
一种个人健康智能体框架，将下游预测器与基于LLM的处理集成，提供更相关、上下文感知且安全的健康响应，经临床医生评分验证。
一种基于海量无标签可穿戴传感器数据的自监督预训练方法，实现无需回顾性标注的健康结局预测，克服高质量标签健康数据集稀缺问题。

title: Advancing Mathematics Research with AI-Driven Formal Proof Search
comment: The first three authors and the last author have equal contributions. The first three authors are in random order
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly excel at mathematical reasoning, but their unreliability limits their utility in mathematics research. A mitigation is using LLMs to generate formal proofs in languages like Lean. We perform the first large-scale evaluation of this method's ability to solve open problems. Our most capable agent autonomously resolved 9 of 353 open Erdős problems at the per-problem cost of a few hundred dollars, proved 44/492 OEIS conjectures, and is being deployed in combinatorics, optimization, graph theory, algebraic geometry, and quantum optics research. A basic agent alternating LLM-based generation with Lean-based verification replicated the Erdős successes but proved costlier on the hardest problems. These findings demonstrate the power of AI-aided formal proof search and shed light on the agent designs that enable it.

AI.tldr: 本文首次大规模评估了使用LLM结合Lean形式化证明系统解决开放数学问题的能力，最强大的智能体以每个问题数百美元的成本，自主解决了353个Erdős开放问题中的9个，并证明了492个OEIS猜想中的44个。
AI.motivation: LLM在数学推理中日益强大但不可靠，限制了其在数学研究中的应用。本文探索通过让LLM生成形式化证明（如Lean语言）来提高可靠性，并首次大规模评估该方法解决开放问题的能力。
AI.method: 设计了一个AI智能体，交替使用LLM生成数学证明候选和Lean形式化验证器进行验证。将这种基本智能体与更先进的智能体在353个开放Erdős问题和492个OEIS猜想上进行大规模评估。
AI.result: 最强大的智能体自主解决了353个Erdős开放问题中的9个（每个问题成本数百美元），证明了44/492个OEIS猜想，并正在组合数学、优化、图论、代数几何和量子光学研究中部署应用。
AI.conclusion: AI辅助的形式化证明搜索是强大且实用的方法，能够以合理的成本解决开放数学问题，并在多个数学领域具有广泛的应用前景。不同的智能体设计方式对解决难度不同的问题有显著影响。
idea_en: A method for automated mathematical theorem proving that iteratively combines LLM-based proof generation with Lean formal proof verification, enabling solving open mathematical problems at a cost of hundreds of dollars per problem.

A dual-agent architecture for mathematical reasoning where a basic agent alternates between LLM generation and Lean verification for cost-effective proof search, while a more advanced agent handles harder problems.
A system for large-scale automated discovery of mathematical conjectures by applying LLM+Lean verification pipeline to open problem databases (Erdős problems and OEIS conjectures).
A cross-domain mathematical proof automation framework capable of operating in combinatorics, optimization, graph theory, algebraic geometry, and quantum optics.
A cost-optimized AI agent design that balances proof generation quality and verification efficiency for solving open mathematical problems.
idea_ch: 一种将LLM生成的数学证明候选与Lean形式化验证器交替迭代结合的自动定理证明方法，能够以每个问题数百美元的成本解决开放数学问题。
一种双智能体架构：基础智能体交替进行LLM生成和Lean验证以进行经济高效的证明搜索，高级智能体则处理最困难的数学问题。
一种将LLM+Lean验证流水线应用于开放问题数据库（Erdős问题和OEIS猜想）的大规模数学猜想自动发现系统。
一种跨领域数学证明自动化框架，能够在组合数学、优化、图论、代数几何和量子光学等多个数学领域运行。
一种成本优化的AI智能体设计方法，在证明生成质量和验证效率之间取得平衡，用于解决开放数学问题。

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Flexible Job Shop Scheduling with Random Job Arrivals
summary: The Flexible Job Shop Scheduling Problem (FJSP) is the optimal allocation of a set of jobs to machines. Two primary challenges persist in FJSP: the unpredictable arrival of future jobs and the combinatorial complexity of the problem, rendering it intractable for conventional mixed-integer linear programming solvers. This paper proposes an event-based \gls{DRL} approach to solve FJSP with random job arrivals. Specifically, we employ the Proximal Policy Optimization algorithm and use lightweight Multi-Layer Perceptrons to train the \gls{DRL} agent for minimizing the total completion time of all jobs. We design the state representation to be directly accessible from the environment, and limit the learning agent to selecting from among a set of well-established dispatching rules. Simulations show that our \gls{DRL} approach outperforms any of the individual dispatching rules on datasets with varying heterogeneity and job arrival rates. We benchmark our \gls{DRL} against an arrival-triggered mixed-integer linear programming solution and show that our method achieves good performance especially when the datasets are heterogeneous.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于事件触发的深度强化学习（DRL）方法，结合近端策略优化（PPO）算法和轻量级多层感知机（MLP），通过从一组成熟的调度规则中选择动作，解决带有随机作业到达的柔性作业车间调度问题（FJSP），在异构数据集上表现优于单个调度规则和混合整数线性规划方法。
AI.motivation: FJSP面临两大挑战：未来作业的不可预测到达和问题的组合复杂性，使得传统混合整数线性规划求解器难以处理。
AI.method: 采用事件驱动的PPO算法，使用轻量级MLP训练DRL代理；状态表示直接从环境中获取；动作空间限定为一组成熟的调度规则（dispatching rules）。
AI.result: 在异构数据集上，DRL方法优于任何单个调度规则；与到达触发的混合整数线性规划方案相比，在异构数据集上表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 事件驱动的DRL方法结合调度规则选择，能有效应对FJSP中的随机作业到达问题，尤其在异构场景下优势明显。
idea_en: An event-based Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) framework for Flexible Job Shop Scheduling Problem (FJSP) with random job arrivals, where the DRL agent selects from a set of dispatching rules at each decision event rather than learning direct scheduling actions.

A state representation design for FJSP that uses directly observable environment features (e.g., machine status, job queue lengths, processing times) without requiring future job arrival information, enabling the system to handle unpredictable job arrivals.

Integration of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm with lightweight Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) for training the scheduling policy, reducing computational overhead compared to traditional MILP solvers.

An arrival-triggered MILP benchmark method that reschedules upon each new job arrival, used as a comparative baseline to evaluate the performance of the DRL-based approach under heterogeneous job distributions.
idea_ch: 一种基于事件驱动的深度强化学习框架，用于处理带有随机作业到达的柔性作业车间调度问题，DRL代理在每个决策事件中从一组调度规则中选择动作，而非学习直接的调度动作。
一种面向FJSP的状态表示设计方法，利用直接可观测的环境特征（如机器状态、作业队列长度、加工时间），无需未来作业到达信息，从而应对不可预测的作业到达。
将近端策略优化算法与轻量级多层感知机相结合的训练方法，用于学习调度策略，相比传统混合整数线性规划求解器大幅降低计算开销。
一种到达触发的MILP重调度基准方法，每次新作业到达时触发重新调度，作为评估DRL方法在异构作业分布下性能的对比基线。

title: LCGuard: Latent Communication Guard for Safe KV Sharing in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems increasingly rely on intermediate communication to coordinate complex tasks. While most existing systems communicate through natural language, recent work shows that latent communication, particularly through transformer key-value (KV) caches, can improve efficiency and preserve richer task-relevant information. However, KV caches also encode contextual inputs, intermediate reasoning states, and agent-specific information, creating an opaque channel through which sensitive content may propagate across agents without explicit textual disclosure. To address this, we introduce \textbf{LCGuard} (Latent Communication Guard), a framework for safe KV-based latent communication in multi-agent LLM systems. LCGuard treats shared KV caches as latent working memory and learns representation-level transformations before cache artifacts are transmitted across agents. We formalize representation-level sensitive information leakage operationally through reconstruction: a shared cache artifact is unsafe if an adversarial decoder can recover agent-specific sensitive inputs from it. This leads to an adversarial training formulation in which the adversary learns to reconstruct sensitive inputs, while LCGuard learns transformations that preserve task-relevant semantics and reduce reconstructable information. Empirical evaluations across multiple model families and multi-agent benchmarks show that LCGuard consistently reduces reconstruction-based leakage and attack success rates while maintaining competitive task performance compared to standard KV-sharing baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LCGuard框架，用于保障多智能体LLM系统中基于KV缓存的潜在通信安全，通过表示级变换防止敏感信息泄露，同时保持任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统越来越多地使用中间通信（特别是KV缓存）来协调任务，但KV缓存会编码上下文输入、中间推理状态和智能体特定信息，可能在不经文本披露的情况下传播敏感内容，存在安全隐患。
AI.method: LCGuard将共享KV缓存视为潜在工作记忆，在缓存伪影跨智能体传输前学习表示级变换。通过对抗训练形式化定义：对抗解码器尝试从共享缓存重建敏感输入，LCGuard学习保留任务相关语义同时减少可重建信息的变换。
AI.result: 在多个模型家族和多智能体基准测试上，LCGuard持续降低了基于重建的泄露和攻击成功率，同时相比标准KV共享基线保持了竞争性的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: LCGuard有效平衡了多智能体系统中KV缓存通信的效率与安全性，为潜在通信通道的安全问题提供了可行解决方案。
idea_en: A method for safe latent communication in multi-agent LLM systems by applying representation-level transformations to shared KV caches before transmission between agents.

An adversarial training framework where a decoder attempts to reconstruct sensitive inputs from shared KV cache artifacts, and the system learns to minimize reconstructable information while preserving task semantics.
A formal operational definition of representation-level sensitive information leakage based on the reconstructability of agent-specific inputs from shared cache artifacts.
idea_ch: 一种多智能体LLM系统中安全潜在通信的方法：在智能体间传输前对共享KV缓存应用表示级变换。
一种对抗训练框架：解码器尝试从共享KV缓存伪影重建敏感输入，系统学习在保留任务语义的同时最小化可重建信息。
一种基于可重建性的表示级敏感信息泄露形式化定义：从共享缓存伪影重建智能体特定输入的能力作为安全度量。

title: Gated DeltaNet-2: Decoupling Erase and Write in Linear Attention
comment: Gated DeltaNet-2 technical report; code at https://github.com/NVlabs/GatedDeltaNet-2
summary: Linear attention replaces the unbounded cache of softmax attention with a fixed-size recurrent state, reducing sequence mixing to linear time and decoding to constant memory. The hard part is not just what to forget, but how to edit this compressed memory without scrambling existing associations. Delta-rule models subtract the current read before writing a new value, and Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) sharpens forgetting with channel-wise decay. But the active edit still uses a single scalar gate to control two different things: how much old content to erase on the key side and how much new content to commit on the value side. We introduce Gated DeltaNet-2, which generalizes both Gated DeltaNet and KDA by inheriting adaptive forgetting and channel-wise decay while addressing their shared limitation, the scalar tie between erasing and writing. Gated Delta Rule-2 separates these roles with a channel-wise erase gate b_t and a channel-wise write gate w_t, reducing to KDA when both gates collapse to the same scalar and to Gated DeltaNet when the decay also collapses. We derive a fast-weight update view, a chunkwise WY algorithm with channel-wise decay absorbed into asymmetric erase factors, and a gate-aware backward pass that preserves efficient parallel training. At 1.3B parameters trained on 100B FineWeb-Edu tokens, Gated DeltaNet-2 achieves the strongest overall results among Mamba-2, Gated DeltaNet, KDA, and Mamba-3 variants across language modeling, commonsense reasoning, and retrieval. Its advantage is most pronounced on long-context RULER needle-in-a-haystack benchmarks, where it improves the evaluated multi-key retrieval setting and remains strong in both recurrent and hybrid settings. Code is available at https://github.com/NVlabs/GatedDeltaNet-2.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Gated DeltaNet-2，通过分离擦除门和写入门（通道级）改进了Delta规则模型，解决了传统单一标量门控同时控制擦除和写入的局限性，在1.3B参数规模下优于Mamba-2、Gated DeltaNet、KDA和Mamba-3等变体。
AI.motivation: 现有线性注意力模型（如Gated DeltaNet和KDA）使用单一标量门同时控制两个不同操作：擦除旧内容（key侧）和写入新内容（value侧），这种耦合限制了记忆编辑的灵活性。
AI.method: 提出Gated Delta Rule-2，将标量门解耦为通道级擦除门b_t和通道级写入门w_t；推导了快速权重更新视角、带通道级衰減的块状WY算法（吸收为非对称擦除因子），以及保持高效并行训练的门感知反向传播。
AI.result: 在1.3B参数/100B FineWeb-Edu训练下，在语言建模、常识推理和检索任务中全面超越Mamba-2、Gated DeltaNet、KDA、Mamba-3；在长上下文RULER多键检索任务中优势最显著，且在循环和混合设置下均表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦擦除和写入门控机制，Gated DeltaNet-2实现了更灵活的压缩记忆编辑，在长上下文检索任务上取得突破，为线性注意力模型提供了新的设计范式。
idea_en: Separated channel-wise erase gate (b_t) and channel-wise write gate (w_t) for linear attention memory editing, decoupling the erasing of old key-side content from the committing of new value-side content.
Chunkwise WY algorithm with channel-wise decay absorbed into asymmetric erase factors, enabling efficient parallel training for the dual-gate delta rule.
Gate-aware backward pass that preserves parallel training efficiency while supporting separate erase and write gates.
Adaptive channel-wise forgetting and editing mechanism that generalizes both Gated DeltaNet and KDA as special cases when gates collapse.
Hybrid architecture combining dual-gated delta rule recurrent layer with standard attention for long-context needle-in-a-haystack retrieval.

title: MOSS: Self-Evolution through Source-Level Rewriting in Autonomous Agent Systems
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Preprint. Code: https://github.com/dav-joy-thon/MOSS
summary: Autonomous agentic systems are largely static after deployment: they do not learn from user interactions, and recurring failures persist until the next human-driven update ships a fix. Self-evolving agents have emerged in response, but all confine evolution to text-mutable artifacts -- skill files, prompt configurations, memory schemas, workflow graphs -- and leave the agent harness untouched. Since routing, hook ordering, state invariants, and dispatch live in code rather than in any text artifact, an entire class of structural failure is physically unreachable from the text layer. We argue that source-level adaptation is a fundamentally more general medium: it is Turing-complete, a strict superset of every text-mutable scope, takes effect deterministically rather than through base-model compliance, and does not erode under long-context drift. We present MOSS, a system that performs self-rewriting at the source level on production agentic substrates. Each evolution is anchored to an automatically curated batch of production-failure evidence and proceeds through a deterministic multi-stage pipeline; code modification is delegated to a pluggable external coding-agent CLI while MOSS retains stage ordering and verdicts. Candidates are verified by replaying the batch against the candidate image in ephemeral trial workers, then promoted via user-consent-gated, in-place container swap with health-probe-gated rollback. On OpenClaw, MOSS lifts a four-task mean grader score from 0.25 to 0.61 in a single cycle without human intervention.

AI.tldr: MOSS是一个能够在源代码级别对生产环境中的自主智能体系统进行自我重写的系统，它通过自动收集失败证据、确定性多阶段流水线处理、外部编码CLI生成修改代码、回放验证和健康检查回滚等机制，实现无需人类干预的自我进化。
AI.motivation: 现有自主智能体系统部署后过于静态，无法从用户交互中学习，重复性故障只能等待人工更新修复。虽然已有自进化智能体方案，但所有进化都局限在文本可变的工件层面（技能文件、提示配置、记忆模式、工作流图），而忽略了对智能体核心框架（路由、钩子排序、状态不变量、调度）的修改。这些核心功能存在于代码中而非文本工件中，因此大量结构性故障在文本层无法触及。
AI.method: MOSS系统提出源代码级别的自我重写方法：1）自动收集生产环境中的失败证据形成批处理；2）通过确定性多阶段流水线进行处理；3）将代码修改委托给可插拔的外部编码智能体CLI，MOSS保留阶段排序和裁决权；4）通过在临时试运行工作器中回放批处理来验证候选修改；5）通过用户同意门控的就地容器替换和健康检查门控的回滚机制进行发布。
AI.result: 在OpenClaw基准测试上，MOSS在单次循环中无需人工干预即将四个任务的平均评分从0.25提升至0.61。
AI.conclusion: 源代码级别的适应是一种根本上更通用的媒介：它是图灵完备的，是每个文本可变作用域的严格超集，能够确定性生效而非依赖基础模型遵从性，并且不会因长上下文漂移而衰减。
